<file path="apps/web/src/app/App.tsx">
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

import { fetchWorkspaceTree, fetchWorkspaceFile, saveWorkspaceFile } from "../services/workspaceApi";

import { useWorkspaceSocket } from "../hooks/useWorkspaceSocket";

import { useIDEContext } from "../context/useIDEContext";

import type {

    WorkspaceNode,

    WorkspaceEvent,

} from "../types/workspace";

import { FileTree } from "../components/FileTree";

import { FileViewer } from "../components/FileViewer";

import { AIChat } from "../components/AIChat";
import { AICouncil } from "../components/AICouncil";

export function App() {

    const {

        setProjectTree,

        setActiveFile,

        setActiveContent,

        addOpenedFile,

    } = useIDEContext();

    const [

        tree,

        setTree,

    ] = useState<WorkspaceNode[]>([]);

    const [

        selectedPath,

        setSelectedPath,

    ] = useState("");

    const [

        fileContent,

        setFileContent,

    ] = useState("");

    const [

        events,

        setEvents,

    ] = useState<WorkspaceEvent[]>([]);

    const socketStatus =

        useWorkspaceSocket(

            event => {

                setEvents(

                    previous => [

                        event,

                        ...previous,

                    ].slice(0, 50),

                );

            },

        );

    useEffect(() => {

        fetchWorkspaceTree()

            .then(tree => {

                setTree(tree);

                setProjectTree(tree);

            })

            .catch(console.error);

    }, []);

    async function handleSelect(

        path: string,

    ) {

        setSelectedPath(path);

        setActiveFile(path);

        addOpenedFile(path);

        const response = await fetch(

            `http://localhost:4302/api/workspace/file?path=${encodeURIComponent(path)}`,

        );

        const json =

            await response.json();

        setFileContent(

            json.content,

        );

        setActiveContent(

            json.content,

        );

    }

    const header = useMemo(

        () =>

            socketStatus === "open"

                ? "WebSocket: connected"

                : "WebSocket: connecting...",

        [

            socketStatus,

        ],

    );

    return (

        <div className="app-shell">

            <header className="topbar">

                <h1>

                    JustAI

                </h1>

                <span>

                    {header}

                </span>

            </header>

            <main className="layout">

                <aside className="panel left">

                    <FileTree

                        nodes={tree}

                        onSelect={handleSelect}

                    />

                </aside>

                <section className="panel center">

                    <FileViewer
                        path={selectedPath}
                        content={fileContent}
                        onSave={async (path, content) => {
                            await saveWorkspaceFile(path, content);
                            setFileContent(content);
                            setActiveContent(content);
                        }}
                    />

                </section>

                <aside className="panel right">

                    <AIChat />
                    <AICouncil />

                </aside>

            </main>

        </div>

    );

}
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/AIChat.tsx">
import type React from "react";

import {
    useEffect,
    useMemo,
    useState,
} from "react";

import {
    askAI,
    fetchAIProviders,
    fetchAIAgents,
    type AIProviderInfo,
    type AIAgentInfo,
} from "../services/aiApi";

import {
    fetchIntegrationStatus,
    getMicrosoftConnectUrl,
    disconnectMicrosoft,
    type MicrosoftStatus,
} from "../services/integrationsApi";

import { useIDEContext } from "../context/useIDEContext";
import type { ChatMessage } from "../types/chat";

export function AIChat() {

    const {
        activeFile,
        activeContent,
        openedFiles,
        projectTree,
    } = useIDEContext();

    const [messages, setMessages] =
        useState<ChatMessage[]>([]);

    const [prompt, setPrompt] =
        useState("");

    const [loading, setLoading] =
        useState(false);

    const [providers, setProviders] =
        useState<AIProviderInfo[]>([]);

    const [provider, setProvider] =
        useState("mock");

    const [agents, setAgents] =
        useState<AIAgentInfo[]>([]);

    const [agent, setAgent] =
        useState("general");

    const [microsoft, setMicrosoft] =
        useState<MicrosoftStatus | null>(null);

    const [error, setError] =
        useState("");

    useEffect(() => {
        Promise.all([
            fetchAIProviders(),
            fetchAIAgents(),
            fetchIntegrationStatus(),
        ])
            .then(([loadedProviders, loadedAgents, microsoftStatus]) => {
                setProviders(loadedProviders);
                setAgents(loadedAgents);
                setMicrosoft(microsoftStatus);

                const configured =
                    loadedProviders.find(
                        item => item.configured,
                    );

                if (configured) {
                    setProvider(configured.id);
                }
            })
            .catch((reason: unknown) => {
                setError(
                    reason instanceof Error
                        ? reason.message
                        : String(reason),
                );
            });
    }, []);

    const selectedProvider =
        useMemo(
            () =>
                providers.find(
                    item => item.id === provider,
                ),
            [providers, provider],
        );

    async function send() {

        if (!prompt.trim() || loading) {
            return;
        }

        const text = prompt.trim();

        setMessages(previous => [
            ...previous,
            {
                id: crypto.randomUUID(),
                role: "user",
                text,
                createdAt: Date.now(),
            },
        ]);

        setPrompt("");
        setLoading(true);
        setError("");

        try {
            const answer =
                await askAI({
                    prompt: text,
                    provider,
                    agent,
                    activeFile,
                    activeContent,
                    openedFiles,
                    projectTree,
                });

            setMessages(previous => [
                ...previous,
                {
                    id: crypto.randomUUID(),
                    role: "assistant",
                    text: answer,
                    createdAt: Date.now(),
                },
            ]);
        }
        catch (reason: unknown) {
            const message =
                reason instanceof Error
                    ? reason.message
                    : String(reason);

            setError(message);
        }
        finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    }

    function handleKeyDown(
        event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement>,
    ) {
        if (
            event.key === "Enter" &&
            (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey)
        ) {
            event.preventDefault();
            void send();
        }
    }

    async function refreshMicrosoft() {
        try {
            setMicrosoft(
                await fetchIntegrationStatus(),
            );
        }
        catch {
            // The panel can remain usable if the status endpoint is temporarily unavailable.
        }
    }

    async function disconnect() {
        await disconnectMicrosoft();
        await refreshMicrosoft();
    }

    return (
        <div className="ai-chat">

            <div className="ai-header">
                <div className="ai-title-row">
                    <div>
                        <h2>Agent</h2>
                        <div className="muted">
                            {selectedProvider
                                ? `${selectedProvider.label} · ${selectedProvider.model}`
                                : "AI agent"}
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="ai-selects">
                        <select
                            value={agent}
                            onChange={event =>
                                setAgent(event.target.value)
                            }
                        >
                            {agents.map(item => (
                                <option
                                    key={item.id}
                                    value={item.id}
                                >
                                    {item.label}
                                </option>
                            ))}
                        </select>

                        <select
                            value={provider}
                            onChange={event =>
                                setProvider(event.target.value)
                            }
                        >
                            {providers.map(item => (
                                <option
                                    key={item.id}
                                    value={item.id}
                                >
                                    {item.label}
                                    {item.configured ? "" : " (not configured)"}
                                </option>
                            ))}
                        </select>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div className="integration-card">
                    <div>
                        <strong>Microsoft Word / OneDrive</strong>
                        <div className="muted">
                            {microsoft?.connected
                                ? "Connected"
                                : "Not connected"}
                        </div>
                    </div>

                    {microsoft?.connected ? (
                        <button
                            className="secondary-button"
                            onClick={() => void disconnect()}
                        >
                            Disconnect
                        </button>
                    ) : (
                        <a
                            className="secondary-button"
                            href={getMicrosoftConnectUrl()}
                            target="_blank"
                            rel="noreferrer"
                        >
                            Connect
                        </a>
                    )}
                </div>

                {!microsoft?.configured && (
                    <div className="notice">
                        Add Microsoft OAuth settings to server/.env to enable Word.
                    </div>
                )}

                {error && (
                    <div className="error">
                        {error}
                    </div>
                )}
            </div>

            <div className="ai-messages">
                {messages.length === 0 && (
                    <div className="ai-placeholder">
                        <strong>Agent ready.</strong>
                        <p>
                            Ask it to read or edit project files, inspect
                            the workspace, or work with a connected Word document.
                        </p>
                        <p>
                            Ctrl/Cmd + Enter — send.
                        </p>
                    </div>
                )}

                {messages.map(message => (
                    <div
                        key={message.id}
                        className={`message ${message.role}`}
                    >
                        <div className="role">
                            {message.role === "user"
                                ? "You"
                                : "JustAI"}
                        </div>

                        <pre>
                            {message.text}
                        </pre>
                    </div>
                ))}
            </div>

            <div className="ai-input">
                <textarea
                    rows={5}
                    value={prompt}
                    onChange={event =>
                        setPrompt(event.target.value)
                    }
                    onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
                    placeholder="Например: прочитай README.md и объясни проект"
                />

                <button
                    onClick={() => void send()}
                    disabled={
                        loading ||
                        !prompt.trim()
                    }
                >
                    {loading
                        ? "Agent working..."
                        : "Run agent"}
                </button>
            </div>

        </div>
    );
}
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/AICouncil.tsx">
import { useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";

import {
    connectCouncilProvider,
    fetchCouncilStatus,
    runCouncil,
    type CouncilProviderId,
    type CouncilProviderStatus,
    type CouncilRunResponse,
} from "../services/councilApi";

import { useIDEContext } from "../context/useIDEContext";

const ALL: CouncilProviderId[] = ["chatgpt", "claude", "deepseek"];

const LABELS: Record<CouncilProviderId, string> = {
    chatgpt: "ChatGPT",
    claude: "Claude",
    deepseek: "DeepSeek",
};

const DEFAULT_ROLES: Record<CouncilProviderId, string> = {
    chatgpt: "architect",
    claude: "critic",
    deepseek: "implementer",
};

export function AICouncil() {
    const { activeFile, activeContent, projectTree } = useIDEContext();
    const [statuses, setStatuses] = useState<CouncilProviderStatus[]>([]);
    const [selected, setSelected] = useState<CouncilProviderId[]>(ALL);
    const [chair, setChair] = useState<CouncilProviderId>("chatgpt");
    const [roles, setRoles] = useState<Record<CouncilProviderId, string>>(DEFAULT_ROLES);
    const [prompt, setPrompt] = useState("");
    const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
    const [error, setError] = useState("");
    const [result, setResult] = useState<CouncilRunResponse | null>(null);

    async function refresh() {
        try {
            setStatuses(await fetchCouncilStatus());
        } catch (reason) {
            setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : String(reason));
        }
    }

    useEffect(() => {
        void refresh();
    }, []);

    const statusMap = useMemo(
        () => new Map(statuses.map(item => [item.id, item])),
        [statuses],
    );

    function toggleProvider(id: CouncilProviderId) {
        setSelected(previous => {
            if (previous.includes(id)) {
                const next = previous.filter(item => item !== id);
                if (chair === id && next.length) setChair(next[0]);
                return next;
            }
            return [...previous, id];
        });
    }

    async function connect(id: CouncilProviderId) {
        setError("");
        try {
            await connectCouncilProvider(id);
            await refresh();
        } catch (reason) {
            setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : String(reason));
        }
    }

    async function run() {
        if (!prompt.trim() || loading || !selected.length) return;
        if (!selected.includes(chair)) {
            setError("Председатель должен быть выбран в составе совета.");
            return;
        }

        setLoading(true);
        setError("");
        try {
            const response = await runCouncil({
                prompt: prompt.trim(),
                providers: selected,
                chair,
                roles,
                projectContext: JSON.stringify(projectTree, null, 2),
                activeFile,
                activeContent,
            });
            setResult(response);
        } catch (reason) {
            setError(reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : String(reason));
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    }

    return (
        <section className="council-card">
            <div className="council-title">
                <div>
                    <h3>AI Council</h3>
                    <div className="muted">Советуется с твоими веб-аккаунтами без API-ключей</div>
                </div>
                <button className="secondary-button" onClick={() => void refresh()}>Обновить</button>
            </div>

            <div className="council-providers">
                {ALL.map(id => {
                    const status = statusMap.get(id);
                    return (
                        <div className="council-provider" key={id}>
                            <label>
                                <input
                                    type="checkbox"
                                    checked={selected.includes(id)}
                                    onChange={() => toggleProvider(id)}
                                />
                                <strong>{LABELS[id]}</strong>
                            </label>
                            <span className={status?.connected ? "council-ok" : "council-off"}>
                                {status?.connected ? "вошёл" : "не подключён"}
                            </span>
                            <select
                                value={roles[id]}
                                disabled={!selected.includes(id)}
                                onChange={event => setRoles(previous => ({ ...previous, [id]: event.target.value }))}
                            >
                                <option value="architect">Архитектор</option>
                                <option value="critic">Критик</option>
                                <option value="implementer">Разработчик</option>
                                <option value="researcher">Исследователь</option>
                            </select>
                            <button className="secondary-button" onClick={() => void connect(id)}>
                                {status?.open ? "Открыть" : "Подключить"}
                            </button>
                        </div>
                    );
                })}
            </div>

            <div className="council-chair">
                <label>
                    Председатель:
                    <select value={chair} onChange={event => setChair(event.target.value as CouncilProviderId)}>
                        {selected.map(id => <option key={id} value={id}>{LABELS[id]}</option>)}
                    </select>
                </label>
                <span className="muted">Председатель получает ответы остальных и собирает единый план.</span>
            </div>

            <textarea
                rows={4}
                value={prompt}
                onChange={event => setPrompt(event.target.value)}
                placeholder="Например: изучите текущий проект, найдите архитектурные проблемы и решите, как реализовать автоматическое управление кодом."
            />

            <button className="primary-button" onClick={() => void run()} disabled={loading || !prompt.trim() || !selected.length}>
                {loading ? "Совет совещается…" : "Созвать AI Council"}
            </button>

            {error && <div className="error">{error}</div>}

            <div className="council-note">
                Первый запуск каждого AI откроет отдельное окно браузера. Войди там в свой аккаунт один раз. Пароли и cookies не передаются JustAI API и не записываются в его базу.
            </div>

            {result && (
                <div className="council-result">
                    <h4>Мнения советников</h4>
                    {result.opinions.map(opinion => (
                        <details key={`${opinion.provider}-${opinion.role}`} open>
                            <summary>{LABELS[opinion.provider]} — {opinion.role}</summary>
                            <pre>{opinion.answer}</pre>
                        </details>
                    ))}
                    <h4>Решение председателя — {LABELS[result.chair.provider]}</h4>
                    <pre>{result.chair.answer}</pre>
                    <div className="notice">{result.executionPolicy}</div>
                </div>
            )}
        </section>
    );
}
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/EventConsole.tsx">
import type { WorkspaceEvent } from '../types/workspace';

interface Props {
    events: WorkspaceEvent[];
}

export function EventConsole({ events }: Props) {
    return (
        <div>
            <h2>Events</h2>
            <div className="events">
                {events.length === 0 ? (
                    <p>No events yet...</p>
                ) : (
                    events.map((event, index) => (
                        <pre key={index}>{JSON.stringify(event, null, 2)}</pre>
                    ))
                )}
            </div>
        </div>
    );
}
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/FileTree.tsx">
import { useState } from 'react';
import type { WorkspaceNode } from '../types/workspace';

interface Props {
    nodes: WorkspaceNode[];
    onSelect: (path: string) => void;
}

export function FileTree({
    nodes,
    onSelect,
}: Props) {
    const sortedNodes = sortNodes(nodes);

    return (
        <div>
            {sortedNodes.map((node) => (
                <TreeItem
                    key={node.path}
                    node={node}
                    onSelect={onSelect}
                />
            ))}
        </div>
    );
}

interface NodeProps {
    node: WorkspaceNode;
    onSelect: (path: string) => void;
}

function TreeItem({
    node,
    onSelect,
}: NodeProps) {
    const [opened, setOpened] = useState(false);
    const isFolder = node.type === 'folder';

    return (
        <div>
            <div
                onClick={() => {
                    if (isFolder) {
                        setOpened((value) => !value);
                    } else {
                        onSelect(node.path);
                    }
                }}
                style={{
                    cursor: 'pointer',
                    userSelect: 'none',
                    padding: '3px 0',
                }}
            >
                {isFolder ? (opened ? '📂 ' : '📁 ') : '📄 '}
                {node.name}
            </div>

            {isFolder &&
                opened &&
                node.children &&
                node.children.length > 0 && (
                    <div style={{ paddingLeft: 18 }}>
                        {sortNodes(node.children).map((child) => (
                            <TreeItem
                                key={child.path}
                                node={child}
                                onSelect={onSelect}
                            />
                        ))}
                    </div>
                )}
        </div>
    );
}

function sortNodes(nodes: WorkspaceNode[]): WorkspaceNode[] {
    return [...nodes].sort((a, b) => {
        if (a.type !== b.type) {
            return a.type === 'folder' ? -1 : 1;
        }

        return a.name.localeCompare(b.name, 'ru', {
            numeric: true,
            sensitivity: 'base',
        });
    });
}
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/components/FileViewer.tsx">
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";

interface Props {

    path: string;

    content: string;

    onSave?: (
        path: string,
        content: string,
    ) => Promise<void>;

}

export function FileViewer({

    path,

    content,

    onSave,

}: Props) {

    const [value, setValue] = useState("");

    const [saving, setSaving] = useState(false);

    useEffect(() => {

        setValue(content);

    }, [content]);

    async function handleSave() {

        if (!path || !onSave) {

            return;

        }

        try {

            setSaving(true);

            await onSave(

                path,

                value,

            );

        }

        finally {

            setSaving(false);

        }

    }

    return (

        <div

            style={{

                display: "flex",

                flexDirection: "column",

                height: "100%",

            }}

        >

            <div

                style={{

                    display: "flex",

                    justifyContent: "space-between",

                    alignItems: "center",

                    marginBottom: 12,

                }}

            >

                <h3>

                    {path || "Select file"}

                </h3>

                <button

                    onClick={handleSave}

                    disabled={!path || !onSave || saving}

                >

                    {

                        saving

                            ? "Saving..."

                            : "Save"

                    }

                </button>

            </div>

            <textarea

                value={value}

                onChange={(e) =>

                    setValue(e.target.value)

                }

                disabled={!path}

                style={{

                    flex: 1,

                    resize: "none",

                    background: "#111",

                    color: "#fff",

                    border: "1px solid #333",

                    padding: 12,

                    fontFamily: "monospace",

                    fontSize: 14,

                    outline: "none",

                }}

            />

        </div>

    );

}

<file path="apps/web/src/context/IDEContextProvider.tsx">
import {

    createContext,

    useState,

} from "react";

import type {

    ReactNode,

} from "react";

import type {

    WorkspaceNode,

} from "../types/workspace";

import type {

    IDEContext,

} from "./IDEContext";

export interface Value extends IDEContext {

    setProjectTree(

        tree: WorkspaceNode[],

    ): void;

    setActiveFile(

        path: string,

    ): void;

    setActiveContent(

        content: string,

    ): void;

    addOpenedFile(

        path: string,

    ): void;

}

export const IDEContextObject =

    createContext<Value>(

        null!,

    );

export function IDEContextProvider({

    children,

}:{

    children: ReactNode;

}){

    const [

        projectTree,

        setProjectTree,

    ]=useState<WorkspaceNode[]>([]);

    const [

        activeFile,

        setActiveFile,

    ]=useState("");

    const [

        activeContent,

        setActiveContent,

    ]=useState("");

    const [

        openedFiles,

        setOpenedFiles,

    ]=useState<string[]>([]);

    function addOpenedFile(

        path:string,

    ){

        setOpenedFiles(

            previous=>{

                if(

                    previous.includes(path)

                ){

                    return previous;

                }

                return[

                    ...previous,

                    path,

                ];

            },

        );

    }

    return(

        <IDEContextObject.Provider

            value={{

                projectTree,

                activeFile,

                activeContent,

                openedFiles,

                setProjectTree,

                setActiveFile,

                setActiveContent,

                addOpenedFile,

            }}

        >

            {children}

        </IDEContextObject.Provider>

    );

}
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/hooks/useAI.ts">
import { useState } from "react";

import { askAI } from "../services/aiApi";

import type { AIMessage } from "../types/ai";

export function useAI() {

    const [messages, setMessages] =
        useState<AIMessage[]>([]);

    const [loading, setLoading] =
        useState(false);

    async function send(
        prompt: string,
    ) {
        if (!prompt.trim()) {
            return;
        }

        setMessages(previous => [
            ...previous,
            {
                role: "user",
                content: prompt,
            },
        ]);

        setLoading(true);

        try {
            const result =
                await askAI({
                    prompt,
                    activeFile: "",
                    activeContent: "",
                    openedFiles: [],
                    projectTree: [],
                });

            setMessages(previous => [
                ...previous,
                {
                    role: "assistant",
                    content: result,
                },
            ]);
        }
        finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    }

    return {
        messages,
        loading,
        send,
    };
}
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/hooks/useWorkspaceSocket.ts">
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { WorkspaceEvent } from '../types/workspace';

export function useWorkspaceSocket(
    onEvent: (event: WorkspaceEvent) => void,
): 'connecting' | 'open' | 'closed' {

    const [status, setStatus] =
        useState<'connecting' | 'open' | 'closed'>('connecting');

    const onEventRef = useRef(onEvent);

    useEffect(() => {
        onEventRef.current = onEvent;
    }, [onEvent]);

    useEffect(() => {

        const socket =
            new WebSocket('ws://localhost:4302');

        socket.onopen = () => {
            setStatus('open');
        };

        socket.onmessage = (message) => {
            try {
                const event =
                    JSON.parse(
                        message.data,
                    ) as WorkspaceEvent;

                onEventRef.current(event);
            }
            catch {
                // ignore malformed messages
            }
        };

        socket.onclose = () => {
            setStatus('closed');
        };

        socket.onerror = () => {
            setStatus('closed');
        };

        return () => {
            socket.close();
        };

    }, []);

    return status;
}
</file>

<file path="apps/web/src/services/aiApi.ts">
export interface AIRequest {

    prompt: string;

    provider?: string;

    agent?: string;

    activeFile: string;

    activeContent: string;

    openedFiles: string[];

    projectTree: unknown;

}

export interface AIProviderInfo {

    id: string;

    label: string;

    configured: boolean;

    model: string;

}

export interface AIAgentInfo {

    id: string;

    label: string;

    description: string;

}

const API_URL =
    import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL ??
    "http://localhost:4302/api";

export async function askAI(
    context: AIRequest,
): Promise<string> {
    const response = await fetch(
        `${API_URL}/ai/chat`,
        {
            method: "POST",
            headers: {
                "Content-Type": "application/json",
            },
            body: JSON.stringify(context),
        },
    );

    if (!response.ok) {
        const text = await response.text();
        throw new Error(
            text || "AI request failed",
        );
    }

    const json =
        await response.json() as {
            answer: string;
        };

    return json.answer;
}

export async function fetchAIProviders():
Promise<AIProviderInfo[]> {
    const response =
        await fetch(
            `${API_URL}/ai/providers`,
        );

    if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
            "Failed to load AI providers",
        );
    }

    const json =
        await response.json() as {
            providers: AIProviderInfo[];
        };

    return json.providers;
}

export async function fetchAIAgents():
Promise<AIAgentInfo[]> {
    const response =
        await fetch(
            `${API_URL}/ai/agents`,
        );

    if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error(
            "Failed to load AI agents",
        );
    }

    const json =
        await response.json() as {
            agents: AIAgentInfo[];
        };

    return json.agents;
}

<file path="apps/web/src/services/councilApi.ts">
export type CouncilProviderId = "chatgpt" | "claude" | "deepseek";

export interface CouncilProviderStatus {
    id: CouncilProviderId;
    label: string;
    url: string;
    connected: boolean;
    open: boolean;
    message?: string;
}

export interface CouncilOpinion {
    provider: CouncilProviderId;
    role: string;
    answer: string;
    durationMs: number;
}

export interface CouncilRunResponse {
    opinions: CouncilOpinion[];
    chair: CouncilOpinion;
    executionPolicy: string;
}

const BASE = "http://localhost:4302/api/ai/council";

export async function fetchCouncilStatus(): Promise<CouncilProviderStatus[]> {
    const response = await fetch(`${BASE}/status`);
    const json = await response.json() as { providers?: CouncilProviderStatus[]; error?: string };
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? `Council status failed: ${response.status}`);
    return json.providers ?? [];
}

export async function connectCouncilProvider(provider: CouncilProviderId): Promise<CouncilProviderStatus> {
    const response = await fetch(`${BASE}/connect/${provider}`, { method: "POST" });
    const json = await response.json() as CouncilProviderStatus & { error?: string };
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? `Could not open ${provider}`);
    return json;
}

export async function runCouncil(request: {
    prompt: string;
    providers: CouncilProviderId[];
    chair: CouncilProviderId;
    roles?: Partial<Record<CouncilProviderId, string>>;
    projectContext?: string;
    activeFile?: string;
    activeContent?: string;
}): Promise<CouncilRunResponse> {
    const response = await fetch(`${BASE}/run`, {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(request),
    });
    const json = await response.json() as CouncilRunResponse & { error?: string };
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error(json.error ?? `Council failed: ${response.status}`);
    return json;
}

<file path="apps/web/src/services/workspaceApi.ts">
import type {
    WorkspaceNode,
} from '../types/workspace';


const API_URL =
    `${import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL ?? 'http://localhost:4302/api'}/workspace`;



export async function fetchWorkspaceTree()
: Promise<WorkspaceNode[]> {

    const response =
        await fetch(
            `${API_URL}/tree`,
        );


    if (!response.ok) {

        throw new Error(
            'Failed to load workspace tree',
        );

    }


    return response.json();

}



export async function fetchWorkspaceFile(
    path: string,
) {

    const response =
        await fetch(
            `${API_URL}/file?path=${encodeURIComponent(path)}`,
        );


    if (!response.ok) {

        throw new Error(
            'Failed to load file',
        );

    }


    return response.json();

}



export async function saveWorkspaceFile(
    path: string,
    content: string,
): Promise<void> {


    const response =
        await fetch(
            `${API_URL}/file`,
            {

                method: 'PUT',

                headers: {

                    'Content-Type':
                        'application/json',

                },

                body: JSON.stringify({

                    path,

                    content,

                }),

            },
        );


    if (!response.ok) {

        throw new Error(
            'Failed to save file',
        );

    }

}

<file path="docs/ai.md">
# JustAI AI Architecture

## Provider layer

JustAI separates provider transport from agent execution.

Implemented providers:

- Mock
- OpenAI
- Anthropic

Each provider receives:

- system instructions;
- user/IDE prompt;
- context;
- filtered tool definitions.

The browser never receives provider API keys.

## Agent profiles

### General Agent

Can use local workspace and connected external services.

### Code Agent

Can inspect and edit local workspace files.

### Office Agent

Can read and edit connected Word documents.

Profiles restrict which tools the model can call.

## Agent loop

```text
user prompt
    |
    v
AIService
    |
    +--> provider
    |      |
    |      +--> final answer
    |      |
    |      +--> tool call
    |
    v
ToolExecutor
    |
    v
ToolRegistry
    |
    v
tool result
    |
    v
provider again
    |
    v
final answer
```

The loop is bounded by `JUSTAI_MAX_AGENT_STEPS`.

## Tool contract

Every tool exposes:

- `name`
- `description`
- `parameters`
- `execute(args)`

This allows the same tools to be described to different AI providers.

## Local tools

- `read_file`
- `list_files`
- `edit_file`

Local tools are constrained to the workspace root.

## Microsoft Word

The Office Agent uses:

```text
Microsoft OAuth
    |
    v
Microsoft Graph
    |
    +-- download OneDrive file
    |
    v
OOXML .docx editor
    |
    v
upload updated file
    |
    v
Word / OneDrive link
```

Microsoft Graph is used for OneDrive file storage and permissions. The `.docx` itself is edited as OOXML before it is uploaded again.

The current Word editor deliberately performs exact text replacement and refuses ambiguous/cross-run replacements. This is safer than silently changing the wrong content.

## Extending the platform

A new integration should add:

1. connection/auth service;
2. API client;
3. one or more tools;
4. integration routes;
5. UI connection card.

The AIService and core ToolRegistry do not need to know integration-specific details.
</file>

# JustAI Architecture

## Current Version

0.2.0

---

# Architecture

JustAI построен по модульной архитектуре.

Каждый модуль является независимой единицей и содержит собственные:

- Routes
- Controller
- Service
- DTO
- Validators
- Types

Инфраструктурные сервисы располагаются отдельно и могут использоваться любым модулем.


Application
│
├── App
├── Container
├── Server
│
├── Core
│ ├── Config
│ ├── Logger
│ ├── Errors
│ ├── Validation
│ ├── Middleware
│ └── Events
│
├── Infrastructure
│ └── FileSystem
│
└── Modules
├── Workspace
├── AI
├── Terminal
├── Editor
└── ...


---

<file path="docs/backend.md">
# Backend

## Current State

Backend is the server-side foundation of JustAI.

At this stage, the backend is responsible for:

- application bootstrap;
- dependency injection;
- HTTP server startup;
- centralized configuration;
- logging;
- validation;
- error handling;
- workspace API;
- internal event communication.

---

## Frozen Dependencies

The backend currently depends on three frozen modules:

### Core — Frozen
Contains:

- ConfigService
- ConsoleLogger
- AppError hierarchy
- Validation framework
- ErrorHandlerMiddleware
- EventBus
- Event base classes and handlers

### Infrastructure — Frozen
Contains:

- LocalFileSystem
- PathResolver
- DirectoryScanner
- IgnoreService

### Workspace — Frozen
Contains:

- WorkspaceController
- WorkspaceService
- WorkspaceRoutes
- DTOs
- Validators
- Workspace event publishing

---

## Backend Responsibilities

The backend layer currently owns:

- `App`
- `Container`
- `Server`

### App
Coordinates startup flow.

### Container
Creates and stores shared application dependencies.

### Server
Configures Express, middleware, routes, and HTTP startup.

---

## Current Architecture

```text
Application
│
├── App
├── Container
├── Server
│
├── Core (Frozen)
│   ├── Config
│   ├── Logger
│   ├── Errors
│   ├── Validation
│   ├── Middleware
│   └── Events
│
├── Infrastructure (Frozen)
│   └── FileSystem
│
└── Workspace (Frozen)
    ├── Controller
    ├── Service
    ├── Routes
    ├── DTO
    ├── Validators
    └── Workspace Events
    Current Goals

The current goal of Backend is to prepare the project for the next runtime layer:

WebSocket transport;
real-time event delivery;
event subscription inside server modules;
future integration with frontend and AI.
What Is Already Complete
centralized config loading;
structured logging;
global error handling;
workspace CRUD API;
request validation;
event bus foundation;
workspace event publishing;
modular dependency injection;
clean startup flow.
What Must Stay Stable

Since the following modules are frozen:

Core
Infrastructure
Workspace

their public contracts must not be broken.

Allowed changes:

bug fixes;
performance improvements;
backward-compatible extensions.

Not allowed:

breaking REST API changes;
DTO contract changes;
public service method changes;
event contract breaks in frozen modules.
Next Backend Step

The next step for Backend is:

create a WebSocket module;
subscribe it to Core Events;
forward workspace events to connected clients;
keep Workspace isolated from transport concerns.

This will make the backend event-driven without modifying frozen modules.
</file>

# Changelog

## 0.1.0 — 25.07.2026

### Added

- Core module:
  - ConfigService
  - ConsoleLogger
  - Error classes
  - Validation framework
  - ErrorHandlerMiddleware
  - EventBus
  - Workspace events

- Infrastructure module:
  - LocalFileSystem
  - PathResolver
  - DirectoryScanner
  - IgnoreService

- Workspace module:
  - Tree scanning
  - File reading
  - File saving
  - File creation
  - Folder creation
  - Path deletion
  - Path renaming
  - Path moving
  - Request validation
  - Workspace event publishing

- Application bootstrap:
  - Container
  - Server
  - App startup flow

- Documentation:
  - architecture.md
  - modules.md

### Changed

- Introduced modular architecture for the backend.
- Replaced direct `process.env` access with `ConfigService`.
- Replaced direct `console.log` usage with `ConsoleLogger`.
- Added centralized error handling through `ErrorHandlerMiddleware`.
- Added request validation for Workspace endpoints.
- Added event-driven communication inside Workspace via `EventBus`.

### Frozen

- Core module
- Infrastructure module
- Workspace module

### Fixed

- Workspace path handling.
- File creation and save behavior.
- Rename and move operations.
- Error responses for missing files and invalid requests.
- EventBus export and module integration issues.

<file path="docs/decisions.md">
# Architecture Decisions

## ADR-001
Date: 25.07.2026

Title:
Core Module Frozen

Decision:
Core module is frozen as version 1.0.

Included components:
- ConfigService
- ConsoleLogger
- AppError
- BadRequestError
- ForbiddenError
- NotFoundError
- ValidationError
- InternalServerError
- Validator
- ValidationResult
- ErrorHandlerMiddleware
- Event
- EventBus
- IEventHandler

Reason:
Core became a stable foundation for configuration, logging, validation, error handling, and events.

Consequences:
- Existing public contracts in Core must not be broken.
- New functionality may only be added in a backward-compatible way.

---

## ADR-002
Date: 25.07.2026

Title:
Infrastructure Module Frozen

Decision:
Infrastructure module is frozen as version 1.0.

Included components:
- LocalFileSystem
- DirectoryScanner
- IgnoreService
- PathResolver

Reason:
File system infrastructure was fully implemented and tested as a stable dependency for higher-level modules.

Consequences:
- Existing infrastructure APIs must remain stable.
- Changes are allowed only for bug fixes and internal improvements.

---

## ADR-003
Date: 25.07.2026

Title:
Workspace Module Frozen

Decision:
Workspace module is frozen as version 1.0.

Included components:
- WorkspaceController
- WorkspaceService
- WorkspaceRoutes
- CreateFileDto
- CreateFolderDto
- SaveFileDto
- DeletePathDto
- RenamePathDto
- MovePathDto
- CreateFileValidator
- SaveFileValidator
- CreateFolderValidator
- DeletePathValidator
- RenamePathValidator
- MovePathValidator

Public API:
- GET /api/workspace/tree
- GET /api/workspace/file
- PUT /api/workspace/file
- POST /api/workspace/file
- POST /api/workspace/folder
- DELETE /api/workspace
- POST /api/workspace/rename
- POST /api/workspace/move

Reason:
Workspace was fully implemented, validated, event-enabled, and tested manually.

Consequences:
- Public Workspace API must not be changed.
- DTO contracts must remain stable.
- New behavior may only be added in a backward-compatible way.
- Existing validation and event publishing behavior must remain intact.

---

## ADR-004
Date: 25.07.2026

Title:
EventBus Adopted as Core Communication Layer

Decision:
EventBus is accepted as the internal event communication mechanism for the project.

Reason:
It provides a stable foundation for decoupled communication between modules such as Workspace, WebSocket, AI, and future services.

Consequences:
- Modules should communicate via events where possible.
- Direct coupling between independent modules should be avoided.
- Event contracts should be treated as part of the Core API.

## Frontend Architecture

Decision:

Frontend построен как отдельное приложение apps/web.

Responsibilities:

- UI rendering
- Workspace visualization
- WebSocket event display
- User interaction

Backend remains source of truth.

Frontend does not access filesystem directly.
</file>

<file path="server/src/app/App.ts">
import { Container } from './Container.js';
import { Server } from './Server.js';

import {
    FileCreatedEvent,
    FileSavedEvent,
    FileDeletedEvent,
    FileMovedEvent,
    FileRenamedEvent,
} from '../core/events/index.js';

import { WorkspaceLogger } from '../core/events/workspace/WorkspaceLogger.js';

export class App {

    private readonly container: Container;

    private readonly server: Server;

    constructor() {

        this.container = new Container();

        this.server = new Server(
            this.container,
        );

    }

    public async start(): Promise<void> {

        await this.container.initialize();

        this.container.webSocketGateway.initialize();

        const logger =
            new WorkspaceLogger();

        this.container.eventBus.subscribe(
            FileCreatedEvent,
            logger,
        );

        this.container.eventBus.subscribe(
            FileSavedEvent,
            logger,
        );

        this.container.eventBus.subscribe(
            FileDeletedEvent,
            logger,
        );

        this.container.eventBus.subscribe(
            FileMovedEvent,
            logger,
        );

        this.container.eventBus.subscribe(
            FileRenamedEvent,
            logger,
        );

        const config =
            this.container
                .getConfigService()
                .get();

        this.server.start(
            config.port,
        );

    }

}
</file>

<file path="server/src/app/bootstrap.ts">
import dotenv from 'dotenv';
import { App } from './App.js';

export async function bootstrap(): Promise<void> {

    dotenv.config();

    const app = new App();

    await app.start();

}
</file>

import { ListFilesTool } from "../modules/ai/tools/ListFilesTool.js";
import { EditFileTool } from "../modules/ai/tools/EditFileTool.js";
import { BrowserCouncilService } from "../modules/ai/council/index.js";

import {
    IntegrationsController,
    MicrosoftOAuthService,
    MicrosoftTokenStore,
    MicrosoftGraphService,
    WordEditTool,
    WordReadTool,
} from "../modules/integrations/index.js";

export class Container {

    private readonly workspaceRoot: string;

    public readonly eventBus: EventBus;

    public readonly fileSystem: LocalFileSystem;
    public readonly pathResolver: PathResolver;
    public readonly ignoreService: IgnoreService;
    public readonly directoryScanner: DirectoryScanner;

    public readonly workspaceService: WorkspaceService;
    public readonly workspaceController: WorkspaceController;

    public readonly webSocketConnectionManager:
        WebSocketConnectionManager;

    public readonly webSocketGateway:
        WebSocketGateway;

    public readonly contextService: ContextService;
    public readonly promptBuilder: PromptBuilder;
    public readonly toolRegistry: ToolRegistry;

    public readonly readFileTool: ReadFileTool;
    public readonly listFilesTool: ListFilesTool;
    public readonly editFileTool: EditFileTool;

    public readonly toolExecutor: ToolExecutor;
    public readonly planner: Planner;
    public readonly agent: Agent;

    public readonly providerFactory: ProviderFactory;
    public readonly agentProfiles: AgentProfileService;
    public readonly aiService: AIService;
    public readonly aiController: AIController;
    public readonly browserCouncil: BrowserCouncilService;

    public readonly microsoftOAuth: MicrosoftOAuthService;
    public readonly microsoftGraph: MicrosoftGraphService;
    public readonly integrationsController:
        IntegrationsController;

    public readonly wordEditTool: WordEditTool;
    public readonly wordReadTool: WordReadTool;

    private readonly configService: ConfigService;
    private readonly logger: ILogger;

    constructor() {

        const currentDirectory =
            process.cwd();

        this.workspaceRoot =
            path.basename(
                currentDirectory,
            ).toLowerCase() === "server"
                ? path.resolve(
                    currentDirectory,
                    "..",
                )
                : currentDirectory;

        this.configService =
            new ConfigService();

        this.logger =
            new ConsoleLogger();

        this.eventBus =
            new EventBus();

        this.fileSystem =
            new LocalFileSystem();

        this.pathResolver =
            new PathResolver(
                this.workspaceRoot,
            );

        this.ignoreService =
            new IgnoreService(
                this.workspaceRoot,
            );

        this.directoryScanner =
            new DirectoryScanner(
                this.fileSystem,
                this.pathResolver,
                this.ignoreService,
            );

        this.workspaceService =
            new WorkspaceService(
                this.fileSystem,
                this.pathResolver,
                this.directoryScanner,
                this.eventBus,
            );

        this.workspaceController =
            new WorkspaceController(
                this.workspaceService,
            );

        this.webSocketConnectionManager =
            new WebSocketConnectionManager();

        this.webSocketGateway =
            new WebSocketGateway(
                this.eventBus,
                this.webSocketConnectionManager,
            );

        this.contextService =
            new ContextService();

        this.promptBuilder =
            new PromptBuilder();

        this.providerFactory =
            new ProviderFactory();

        this.browserCouncil =
            new BrowserCouncilService(this.workspaceRoot);

        this.agentProfiles =
            new AgentProfileService();

        const defaultProvider =
            this.providerFactory.create(
                process.env.JUSTAI_PROVIDER ?? "mock",
            );

        this.toolRegistry =
            new ToolRegistry();

        this.readFileTool =
            new ReadFileTool(
                this.workspaceRoot,
            );

        this.listFilesTool =
            new ListFilesTool(
                this.workspaceRoot,
            );

        this.editFileTool =
            new EditFileTool(
                this.workspaceRoot,
            );

        this.toolRegistry.register(
            this.readFileTool,
        );

        this.toolRegistry.register(
            this.listFilesTool,
        );

        this.toolRegistry.register(
            this.editFileTool,
        );

        const tokenStore =
            new MicrosoftTokenStore(
                this.workspaceRoot,
            );

        this.microsoftOAuth =
            new MicrosoftOAuthService(
                {
                    clientId:
                        process.env.MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID ?? "",
                    clientSecret:
                        process.env.MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET ?? "",
                    tenant:
                        process.env.MICROSOFT_TENANT ?? "common",
                    redirectUri:
                        process.env.MICROSOFT_REDIRECT_URI ??
                        "http://localhost:4302/api/integrations/microsoft/callback",
                },
                tokenStore,
            );

        this.microsoftGraph =
            new MicrosoftGraphService(
                this.microsoftOAuth,
            );

        this.wordEditTool =
            new WordEditTool(
                this.microsoftGraph,
            );

        this.wordReadTool =
            new WordReadTool(
                this.microsoftGraph,
            );

        this.toolRegistry.register(
            this.wordEditTool,
        );

        this.toolRegistry.register(
            this.wordReadTool,
        );

        this.toolExecutor =
            new ToolExecutor(
                this.toolRegistry,
            );

        this.planner =
            new Planner();

        this.agent =
            new Agent(
                this.planner,
                this.toolExecutor,
            );

        this.aiService =
            new AIService(
                defaultProvider,
                this.providerFactory,
                this.contextService,
                this.toolRegistry,
                this.promptBuilder,
                this.agent,
                this.agentProfiles,
            );

        this.aiController =
            new AIController(
                this.aiService,
                this.providerFactory,
                this.agentProfiles,
                this.browserCouncil,
            );

        this.integrationsController =
            new IntegrationsController(
                this.microsoftOAuth,
            );
    }

    public getConfigService(): ConfigService {
        return this.configService;
    }

    public getLogger(): ILogger {
        return this.logger;
    }

    public async initialize(): Promise<void> {
        await this.ignoreService.initialize();
    }

    public getAvailableTools(): string[] {
        return this.toolRegistry
            .list()
            .map(tool => tool.name);
    }
}

<file path="server/src/app/Server.ts">
import express, {
    type Express,
} from 'express';

import cors from 'cors';
import http from 'node:http';

import { createAIRouter } from '../modules/ai/index.js';

import { Container } from './Container.js';

import { ErrorHandlerMiddleware } from '../core/middleware/ErrorHandlerMiddleware.js';

import { createWorkspaceRouter } from '../modules/workspace/WorkspaceRoutes.js';
import { createIntegrationsRouter } from "../modules/integrations/index.js";

export class Server {

    private readonly app: Express;

    private readonly errorHandler: ErrorHandlerMiddleware;

    constructor(
        private readonly container: Container,
    ) {

        this.app = express();

        this.errorHandler =
            new ErrorHandlerMiddleware();

        this.configure();
        this.routes();
        this.errors();
        

    }

    private configure(): void {

        this.app.use(
            cors(),
        );

        this.app.use(
            express.json(),
        );

    }

    private routes(): void {

        const aiRouter =
            createAIRouter(
                this.container.aiController,
            );

        this.app.use(
            '/api/ai',
            aiRouter,
        );

        const workspaceRouter =
            createWorkspaceRouter(
                this.container.workspaceController,
            );

        this.app.use(
            '/api/workspace',
            workspaceRouter,
        );

        const integrationsRouter =
            createIntegrationsRouter(
                this.container.integrationsController,
            );

        this.app.use(
            "/api/integrations",
            integrationsRouter,
        );

        this.app.get(
            '/',
            (_, res) => {
                res.json({
                    name: "JustAI",
                    status: "ok",
                    web: "http://localhost:3000/",
                    health: "http://localhost:4302/api/health",
                });
            },
        );

        this.app.get(
            '/api/health',
            (_, res) => {

                res.json({

                    status: 'ok',

                    version: '0.2.0',

                });

            },
        );

    }

    private errors(): void {

        this.app.use(
            this.errorHandler.handle.bind(
                this.errorHandler,
            ),
        );

    }

    public start(
        port: number,
    ): void {

        const logger =
            this.container.getLogger();

        const httpServer =
            http.createServer(
                this.app,
            );

        this.container.webSocketConnectionManager.attach(
            httpServer,
        );

        httpServer.listen(
            port,
            () => {

                logger.info(
                    `🚀 JustAI Server running on http://localhost:${port}`,
                );

            },
        );

    }

}
</file>

<file path="server/src/core/events/workspace/WorkspaceLogger.ts">
import { IEventHandler } from '../IEventHandler.js';

import { FileCreatedEvent } from './FileCreatedEvent.js';
import { FileSavedEvent } from './FileSavedEvent.js';
import { FileDeletedEvent } from './FileDeletedEvent.js';
import { FileMovedEvent } from './FileMovedEvent.js';
import { FileRenamedEvent } from './FileRenamedEvent.js';

export class WorkspaceLogger
    implements
        IEventHandler<FileCreatedEvent>,
        IEventHandler<FileSavedEvent>,
        IEventHandler<FileDeletedEvent>,
        IEventHandler<FileMovedEvent>,
        IEventHandler<FileRenamedEvent> {

    public async handle(
        event:
            | FileCreatedEvent
            | FileSavedEvent
            | FileDeletedEvent
            | FileMovedEvent
            | FileRenamedEvent,
    ): Promise<void> {

        if (event instanceof FileCreatedEvent) {

            console.log(
                `[Workspace] File created: ${event.path}`,
            );

            return;

        }

        if (event instanceof FileSavedEvent) {

            console.log(
                `[Workspace] File saved: ${event.path}`,
            );

            return;

        }

        if (event instanceof FileDeletedEvent) {

            console.log(
                `[Workspace] File deleted: ${event.path}`,
            );

            return;

        }

        if (event instanceof FileRenamedEvent) {

            console.log(
                `[Workspace] File renamed: ${event.oldPath} -> ${event.newPath}`,
            );

            return;

        }

        if (event instanceof FileMovedEvent) {

            console.log(
                `[Workspace] File moved: ${event.source} -> ${event.destination}`,
            );

        }

    }

}
</file>

<file path="server/src/core/events/EventBus.ts">
import { Event } from './Event.js';
import { IEventHandler } from './IEventHandler.js';

export class EventBus {

    private readonly handlers =
        new Map<
            string,
            IEventHandler<any>[]
        >();

    public subscribe<T extends Event>(
        event: new (...args: any[]) => T,
        handler: IEventHandler<T>,
    ): void {

        const key =
            event.name;

        if (
            !this.handlers.has(
                key,
            )
        ) {

            this.handlers.set(
                key,
                [],
            );

        }

        this.handlers
            .get(key)!
            .push(handler);

    }

    public async publish<T extends Event>(
        event: T,
    ): Promise<void> {

        const handlers =
            this.handlers.get(
                event.constructor.name,
            );

        if (!handlers) {

            return;

        }

        for (
            const handler
            of handlers
        ) {

            await handler.handle(
                event,
            );

        }

    }

}
</file>

export interface IEventHandler<

<file path="server/src/core/middleware/ErrorHandlerMiddleware.ts">
import type {
    NextFunction,
    Request,
    Response,
} from 'express';

import { AppError } from '../errors/AppError.js';

export class ErrorHandlerMiddleware {

    public handle(
        error: unknown,
        _: Request,
        res: Response,
        __: NextFunction,
    ): void {

        if (error instanceof AppError) {

            res.status(
                error.status,
            ).json({

                success: false,

                error: {

                    code: error.code,

                    message: error.message,

                },

            });

            return;

        }

        console.error(error);

        res.status(500).json({

            success: false,

            error: {

                code: 'INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR',

                message: 'Internal server error.',

            },

        });

    }

}

<file path="server/src/core/validation/ValidationResult.ts">
export type ValidationResult<T> =
    | {
        success: true;
        value: T;
    }
    | {
        success: false;
        message: string;
    };

<file path="server/src/core/validation/Validator.ts">
import { ValidationResult } from './ValidationResult.js';

export abstract class Validator<T> {

    public abstract validate(
        data: unknown,
    ): ValidationResult<T>;

    protected success<V>(
        value: V,
    ): ValidationResult<V> {

        return {

            success: true,

            value,

        };

    }

    protected failure<V>(
        message: string,
    ): ValidationResult<V> {

        return {

            success: false,

            message,

        };

    }

    protected requiredString(

        value: unknown,

        field: string,

    ): ValidationResult<string> {

        if (

            typeof value !== 'string'

        ) {

            return this.failure(

                `Field "${field}" must be a string.`,

            );

        }

        if (

            value.trim() === ''

        ) {

            return this.failure(

                `Field "${field}" cannot be empty.`,

            );

        }

        return this.success(

            value,

        );

    }

    protected optionalString(

        value: unknown,

        field: string,

    ): ValidationResult<string | undefined> {

        if (

            value === undefined

        ) {

            return this.success(

                undefined,

            );

        }

        if (

            typeof value !== 'string'

        ) {

            return this.failure(

                `Field "${field}" must be a string.`,

            );

        }

        return this.success(

            value,

        );

    }

}
</file>

<file path="server/src/infrastructure/filesystem/DirectoryScanner.ts">
import { LocalFileSystem } from './LocalFileSystem.js';
import { PathResolver } from './PathResolver.js';
import { IgnoreService } from './IgnoreService.js';



export interface WorkspaceNode {

    name: string;

    path: string;

    type: 'file' | 'folder';

    children?: WorkspaceNode[];

}



export class DirectoryScanner {


    constructor(

        private readonly fileSystem: LocalFileSystem,

        private readonly pathResolver: PathResolver,

        private readonly ignoreService: IgnoreService,

    ) {}



    /**
     * Сканирование workspace
     */
    public async scan(): Promise<WorkspaceNode[]> {


        return this.scanDirectory(
            this.pathResolver.resolve(''),
            '',
        );


    }




    private async scanDirectory(

        absolutePath: string,

        relativePath: string,

    ): Promise<WorkspaceNode[]> {


        const entries =
            await this.fileSystem.readDirectory(
                absolutePath,
            );



        const nodes:
            WorkspaceNode[] = [];



        for (
            const entry
            of entries
        ) {


            const entryRelativePath =
                relativePath
                    ? `${relativePath}/${entry.name}`
                    : entry.name;



            /**
             * IgnoreService работает по имени
             */
            if (
                this.ignoreService.shouldIgnore(
                    entry.name,
                )
            ) {

                continue;

            }



            const entryAbsolutePath =
                `${absolutePath}/${entry.name}`;



            if (
                entry.isDirectory()
            ) {


                const children =
                    await this.scanDirectory(
                        entryAbsolutePath,
                        entryRelativePath,
                    );



                nodes.push({

                    name:
                        entry.name,

                    path:
                        entryRelativePath,

                    type:
                        'folder',

                    children,

                });


                continue;

            }



            nodes.push({

                name:
                    entry.name,

                path:
                    entryRelativePath,

                type:
                    'file',

            });


        }



        return nodes;


    }


}
</file>

<file path="server/src/infrastructure/filesystem/IgnoreService.ts">
import { promises as fs } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';

export class IgnoreService {

    private readonly ignored = new Set<string>([
        '.git',
        'node_modules',
        'dist',
        'build',
        '.next',
        '.idea',
        '.vscode',
        '.DS_Store',
        'coverage',
        'tests',
    ]);

    constructor(
        private readonly workspaceRoot: string,
    ) {}

    public async initialize(): Promise<void> {

        const gitignore = path.join(
            this.workspaceRoot,
            '.gitignore',
        );

        try {

            const content = await fs.readFile(
                gitignore,
                'utf8',
            );

            for (const line of content.split('\n')) {

                const rule = line.trim();

                if (
                    rule.length === 0 ||
                    rule.startsWith('#')
                ) {
                    continue;
                }

                this.ignored.add(rule);

            }

        }
        catch {
            // .gitignore отсутствует — это нормально
        }

    }

    public shouldIgnore(name: string): boolean {

        return this.ignored.has(name);

    }

    public getRules(): string[] {

        return [...this.ignored];

    }

}
</file>

<file path="server/src/infrastructure/filesystem/LocalFileSystem.ts">
import fs from 'node:fs/promises';



export class LocalFileSystem {


    private readonly fs = fs;



    /**
     * Проверка существования
     */
    public async exists(
        path: string,
    ): Promise<boolean> {

        try {

            await this.fs.access(
                path,
            );

            return true;

        }
        catch {

            return false;

        }

    }



    /**
     * Чтение файла
     */
    public async readFile(
        path: string,
    ): Promise<string> {

        return this.fs.readFile(
            path,
            'utf-8',
        );

    }



    /**
     * Запись файла
     */
    public async writeFile(
        path: string,
        content: string,
    ): Promise<void> {

        await this.fs.writeFile(
            path,
            content,
            'utf-8',
        );

    }



    /**
     * Создание папки
     */
    public async mkdir(
        path: string,
    ): Promise<void> {

        await this.fs.mkdir(
            path,
            {
                recursive:true,
            },
        );

    }



    /**
     * Удаление файла или папки
     */
    public async delete(
        path:string,
    ): Promise<void> {


        await this.fs.rm(
            path,
            {
                recursive:true,
                force:true,
            },
        );


    }



    /**
     * Переименование
     */
    public async rename(
        oldPath:string,
        newPath:string,
    ): Promise<void> {


        await this.fs.rename(
            oldPath,
            newPath,
        );


    }



    /**
     * Перемещение
     */
    public async move(
        source:string,
        destination:string,
    ): Promise<void> {


        await this.fs.rename(
            source,
            destination,
        );


    }



    /**
     * Получение содержимого директории
     */
    public async readDirectory(
        path:string,
    ) {


        return this.fs.readdir(
            path,
            {
                withFileTypes:true,
            },
        );


    }



    /**
     * Получение информации о файле
     */
    public async stat(
        path:string,
    ) {


        return this.fs.stat(
            path,
        );


    }


}
</file>

<file path="server/src/infrastructure/filesystem/PathResolver.ts">
import path from 'node:path';

import { ForbiddenError } from '../../core/errors/ForbiddenError.js';

export class PathResolver {

    constructor(
        private readonly workspaceRoot: string,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Абсолютный путь до workspace
     */
    public getRoot(): string {
        return this.workspaceRoot;
    }

    /**
     * Проверяет, что путь находится внутри workspace
     */
    public isInsideWorkspace(targetPath: string): boolean {

        const absolute = path.resolve(this.workspaceRoot, targetPath);

        return absolute.startsWith(this.workspaceRoot);

    }

    /**
     * Преобразует относительный путь в абсолютный
     */
    public resolve(relativePath: string): string {

        const absolute = path.resolve(this.workspaceRoot, relativePath);

        if (!absolute.startsWith(this.workspaceRoot)) {
            throw new ForbiddenError(
                'Access outside workspace is forbidden.'
            );
        }

        return absolute;

    }

    /**
     * Возвращает путь относительно workspace
     */
    public relative(absolutePath: string): string {

        return path.relative(this.workspaceRoot, absolutePath);

    }

}
</file>

<file path="server/src/modules/ai/agent/Agent.ts">
import type {
    AIToolCall,
} from "../contracts/AIProvider.js";

import { ToolExecutor } from "../tools/ToolExecutor.js";
import { Planner } from "./Planner.js";

export class Agent {

    constructor(

        private readonly planner: Planner,

        private readonly executor: ToolExecutor,

    ) {}

    public async execute(
        prompt: string,
    ): Promise<string | null> {

        const call =
            this.planner.plan(
                prompt,
            );

        if (!call) {

            return null;

        }

        return this.executeToolCall(
            call,
        );

    }

    public async executeToolCall(

        call: AIToolCall,

    ): Promise<string> {

        return this.executor.execute({

            tool:
                call.tool,

            arguments:
                call.arguments,

        });

    }

}
</file>

<file path="server/src/modules/ai/agent/Planner.ts">
import type { ToolCall } from "../tools/ToolCall.js";

export class Planner {

    public plan(
        prompt: string,
    ): ToolCall | null {

        const match =
            prompt.match(
                /^(?:прочитай|открой|read|open)\s+(?:файл\s+|the\s+)?(?:"([^"]+)"|'([^']+)'|`([^`]+)`|([^\s]+))/i,
            );

        if (!match) {
            return null;
        }

        const filePath =
            match[1] ??
            match[2] ??
            match[3] ??
            match[4];

        if (!filePath) {
            return null;
        }

        return {
            tool: "read_file",
            arguments: {
                path: filePath,
            },
        };
    }
}
</file>
