<file path="server/src/modules/ai/council/BrowserCouncilService.ts">
import path from "node:path";
import fs from "node:fs/promises";

import { chromium, type BrowserContext, type Page } from "playwright";

export type CouncilProviderId = "chatgpt" | "claude" | "deepseek";

export interface CouncilRole {
    provider: CouncilProviderId;
    role: "architect" | "critic" | "implementer" | "researcher" | "chair";
}

export interface CouncilProviderStatus {
    id: CouncilProviderId;
    label: string;
    url: string;
    connected: boolean;
    open: boolean;
    message?: string;
}

export interface CouncilRunRequest {
    prompt: string;
    providers: CouncilProviderId[];
    chair: CouncilProviderId;
    roles?: Partial<Record<CouncilProviderId, CouncilRole["role"]>>;
    projectContext?: string;
    activeFile?: string;
    activeContent?: string;
}

export interface CouncilOpinion {
    provider: CouncilProviderId;
    role: string;
    answer: string;
    durationMs: number;
}

export interface CouncilRunResponse {
    opinions: CouncilOpinion[];
    chair: CouncilOpinion;
    executionPolicy: string;
}

interface ProviderDefinition {
    id: CouncilProviderId;
    label: string;
    url: string;
    loginMarkers: string[];
    composerSelectors: string[];
    assistantSelectors: string[];
    sendSelectors: string[];
}

const PROVIDERS: ProviderDefinition[] = [
    {
        id: "chatgpt",
        label: "ChatGPT",
        url: "https://chatgpt.com/",
        loginMarkers: ["Log in", "Sign up"],
        composerSelectors: [
            "textarea[placeholder*='Message']",
            "textarea[placeholder*='message']",
            "[contenteditable='true'][data-lexical-editor='true']",
            "[contenteditable='true']",
        ],
        assistantSelectors: [
            "[data-message-author-role='assistant']",
            "article[data-testid^='conversation-turn'] [data-message-author-role='assistant']",
        ],
        sendSelectors: [
            "button[data-testid='send-button']",
            "button[aria-label*='Send']",
            "button[aria-label*='send']",
        ],
    },
    {
        id: "claude",
        label: "Claude",
        url: "https://claude.ai/new",
        loginMarkers: ["Log in", "Sign up"],
        composerSelectors: [
            "div[contenteditable='true']",
            "textarea[placeholder*='Reply']",
            "textarea",
        ],
        assistantSelectors: [
            "[data-testid='assistant-message']",
            "div.font-claude-message",
            "div[class*='font-claude']",
        ],
        sendSelectors: [
            "button[aria-label*='Send']",
            "button[aria-label*='send']",
            "button[type='submit']",
        ],
    },
    {
        id: "deepseek",
        label: "DeepSeek",
        url: "https://chat.deepseek.com/",
        loginMarkers: ["Log in", "Sign up", "登录", "注册"],
        composerSelectors: [
            "textarea",
            "div[contenteditable='true']",
        ],
        assistantSelectors: [
            ".ds-markdown",
            "div[class*='ds-markdown']",
            "[class*='assistant']",
        ],
        sendSelectors: [
            "button[aria-label*='Send']",
            "button[aria-label*='send']",
            "button[type='submit']",
        ],
    },
];

export class BrowserCouncilService {
    private readonly contexts = new Map<CouncilProviderId, BrowserContext>();

    constructor(private readonly workspaceRoot: string) {}

    private definition(id: CouncilProviderId): ProviderDefinition {
        const definition = PROVIDERS.find(item => item.id === id);
        if (!definition) {
            throw new Error(`Unknown browser council provider: ${id}`);
        }
        return definition;
    }

    private profileRoot(id: CouncilProviderId): string {
        return path.join(
            this.workspaceRoot,
            ".justai",
            "browser-profiles",
            id,
        );
    }

    private async contextFor(id: CouncilProviderId): Promise<BrowserContext> {
        const existing = this.contexts.get(id);
        if (existing) {
            return existing;
        }

        await fs.mkdir(this.profileRoot(id), { recursive: true });

        const context = await chromium.launchPersistentContext(
            this.profileRoot(id),
            {
                headless: false,
                viewport: null,
                channel: process.env.JUSTAI_BROWSER_CHANNEL || undefined,
                args: ["--start-maximized"],
            },
        );

        context.on("close", () => {
            this.contexts.delete(id);
        });

        this.contexts.set(id, context);
        return context;
    }

    private async pageFor(id: CouncilProviderId): Promise<Page> {
        const context = await this.contextFor(id);
        const pages = context.pages();
        const page = pages[0] ?? await context.newPage();

        if (!page.url().startsWith(this.definition(id).url)) {
            await page.goto(this.definition(id).url, { waitUntil: "domcontentloaded", timeout: 60000 });
        }

        return page;
    }

    private async firstVisible(page: Page, selectors: string[]) {
        for (const selector of selectors) {
            const locator = page.locator(selector).filter({ visible: true }).first();
            if (await locator.count().catch(() => 0)) {
                return locator;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private async isLoggedIn(page: Page, definition: ProviderDefinition): Promise<boolean> {
        const composer = await this.firstVisible(page, definition.composerSelectors);
        if (!composer) {
            return false;
        }

        const bodyText = (await page.locator("body").innerText().catch(() => "")).slice(0, 12000);
        return !definition.loginMarkers.some(marker => bodyText.includes(marker)) || Boolean(composer);
    }

    public async status(): Promise<CouncilProviderStatus[]> {
        const result: CouncilProviderStatus[] = [];

        for (const definition of PROVIDERS) {
            try {
                const context = this.contexts.get(definition.id);
                if (!context) {
                    result.push({
                        id: definition.id,
                        label: definition.label,
                        url: definition.url,
                        connected: false,
                        open: false,
                        message: "Browser not started. Click Connect to open a persistent browser profile.",
                    });
                    continue;
                }

                const page = await this.pageFor(definition.id);
                result.push({
                    id: definition.id,
                    label: definition.label,
                    url: definition.url,
                    connected: await this.isLoggedIn(page, definition),
                    open: true,
                });
            } catch (error) {
                result.push({
                    id: definition.id,
                    label: definition.label,
                    url: definition.url,
                    connected: false,
                    open: false,
                    message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
                });
            }
        }

        return result;
    }

    public async connect(id: CouncilProviderId): Promise<CouncilProviderStatus> {
        const definition = this.definition(id);
        const page = await this.pageFor(id);
        await page.bringToFront();

        return {
            id,
            label: definition.label,
            url: definition.url,
            connected: await this.isLoggedIn(page, definition),
            open: true,
            message: "If you are not signed in, sign in in this browser window. The session is stored only in the local JustAI browser profile.",
        };
    }

    private async send(page: Page, definition: ProviderDefinition, prompt: string): Promise<string> {
        const composer = await this.firstVisible(page, definition.composerSelectors);
        if (!composer) {
            throw new Error(`${definition.label}: chat input was not found. The site may require you to sign in first or its UI may have changed.`);
        }

        const before = await this.responseTexts(page, definition);

        await composer.click();
        await composer.fill(prompt);

        const sendButton = await this.firstVisible(page, definition.sendSelectors);
        if (sendButton) {
            await sendButton.click();
        } else {
            await composer.press("Enter");
        }

        const deadline = Date.now() + Number(process.env.JUSTAI_COUNCIL_TIMEOUT_MS ?? 120000);
        let last = "";
        let stableSince = 0;

        while (Date.now() < deadline) {
            await page.waitForTimeout(1200);
            const current = await this.responseTexts(page, definition);
            const candidate = current[current.length - 1] ?? "";

            if (candidate && (!before.includes(candidate) || current.length > before.length)) {
                if (candidate !== last) {
                    last = candidate;
                    stableSince = Date.now();
                } else if (Date.now() - stableSince > 2200) {
                    return candidate.trim();
                }
            }
        }

        if (last) {
            return last.trim();
        }

        throw new Error(`${definition.label}: timed out waiting for the AI response.`);
    }

    private async responseTexts(page: Page, definition: ProviderDefinition): Promise<string[]> {
        for (const selector of definition.assistantSelectors) {
            const locator = page.locator(selector);
            const count = await locator.count().catch(() => 0);
            if (count > 0) {
                const values = await locator.allInnerTexts().catch(() => []);
                const cleaned = values.map(value => value.trim()).filter(Boolean);
                if (cleaned.length) {
                    return cleaned;
                }
            }
        }
        return [];
    }

    private rolePrompt(role: string, provider: CouncilProviderId): string {
        const roleText: Record<string, string> = {
            architect: "Ты архитектор проекта. Определи правильную архитектуру, зависимости, риски и порядок изменений.",
            critic: "Ты независимый критик. Ищи ошибки, противоречия, скрытые риски, регрессии и плохие предположения в решении.",
            implementer: "Ты ведущий разработчик. Предложи конкретный технический план реализации, включая файлы, интерфейсы, тесты и безопасный способ внесения изменений.",
            researcher: "Ты исследователь. Проверь факты, актуальные ограничения инструментов и предложи наиболее надёжный путь.",
            chair: "Ты председатель совета. Сведи мнения в одно решение, разреши противоречия и выдай план, который JustAI сможет выполнить локальными инструментами.",
        };

        return [
            `Ты работаешь в JustAI как роль: ${role}.`,
            roleText[role] ?? roleText.researcher,
            `Твой провайдер: ${provider}. Не притворяйся, что ты можешь напрямую менять локальные файлы. Ты даёшь совет председателю.`,
            "Отвечай структурированно и конкретно. Не проси пользователя пересылать пароль, cookie или токены.",
        ].join("\n");
    }

    private buildAdvisorPrompt(request: CouncilRunRequest, role: string): string {
        return [
            this.rolePrompt(role, "advisor" as CouncilProviderId),
            "",
            "===== USER TASK =====",
            request.prompt,
            "",
            "===== PROJECT CONTEXT =====",
            request.projectContext ?? "No project tree supplied.",
            "",
            "===== ACTIVE FILE =====",
            request.activeFile ?? "",
            request.activeContent ?? "",
            "",
            "Сначала дай самостоятельное мнение. Не соглашайся автоматически с другими участниками, которых ты ещё не видел.",
        ].join("\n");
    }

    private buildChairPrompt(request: CouncilRunRequest, opinions: CouncilOpinion[]): string {
        return [
            this.rolePrompt("chair", request.chair),
            "",
            "===== USER TASK =====",
            request.prompt,
            "",
            "===== PROJECT CONTEXT =====",
            request.projectContext ?? "No project tree supplied.",
            "",
            "===== COUNCIL OPINIONS =====",
            ...opinions.map((opinion, index) => [
                `--- ADVISOR ${index + 1}: ${opinion.provider} / ${opinion.role} ---`,
                opinion.answer,
            ].join("\n")),
            "",
            "===== CHAIR OUTPUT FORMAT =====",
            "1. Decision",
            "2. Why this decision wins over alternatives",
            "3. Exact implementation plan",
            "4. Files likely to change",
            "5. Tests/checks required",
            "6. Risks and rollback plan",
            "7. EXECUTION: write YES only if the plan is safe for JustAI to execute after explicit user approval; otherwise write NO.",
            "",
            "Do not claim that you changed local files. You are advising the local JustAI agent.",
        ].join("\n");
    }

    public async run(request: CouncilRunRequest): Promise<CouncilRunResponse> {
        if (!request.prompt?.trim()) {
            throw new Error("Council prompt is required.");
        }

        const uniqueProviders = [...new Set(request.providers)].filter(Boolean);
        if (!uniqueProviders.length) {
            throw new Error("Select at least one AI council provider.");
        }
        if (!uniqueProviders.includes(request.chair)) {
            throw new Error("The chair must be one of the selected council providers.");
        }

        const opinions: CouncilOpinion[] = [];

        for (const provider of uniqueProviders) {
            const definition = this.definition(provider);
            const page = await this.pageFor(provider);
            await page.bringToFront();

            if (!(await this.isLoggedIn(page, definition))) {
                throw new Error(`${definition.label} is not signed in. Click Connect and sign in once in the opened browser window.`);
            }

            const role = request.roles?.[provider] ?? (provider === request.chair ? "architect" : "researcher");
            const started = Date.now();
            const answer = await this.send(page, definition, this.buildAdvisorPrompt(request, role));

            opinions.push({
                provider,
                role,
                answer,
                durationMs: Date.now() - started,
            });
        }

        const chairDefinition = this.definition(request.chair);
        const chairPage = await this.pageFor(request.chair);
        await chairPage.bringToFront();

        if (!(await this.isLoggedIn(chairPage, chairDefinition))) {
            throw new Error(`${chairDefinition.label} is not signed in.`);
        }

        const started = Date.now();
        const chairAnswer = await this.send(
            chairPage,
            chairDefinition,
            this.buildChairPrompt(request, opinions),
        );

        const chair: CouncilOpinion = {
            provider: request.chair,
            role: "chair",
            answer: chairAnswer,
            durationMs: Date.now() - started,
        };

        return {
            opinions,
            chair,
            executionPolicy: "Browser council only advises. JustAI never applies file changes from an external browser response without an explicit execution step in the local agent.",
        };
    }

    public async close(): Promise<void> {
        for (const context of this.contexts.values()) {
            await context.close().catch(() => undefined);
        }
        this.contexts.clear();
    }
}
</file>

<file path="server/src/modules/ai/parser/ArgumentParser.ts">
export class ArgumentParser {

    public parseReadFile(

        prompt: string,

    ): string {

        const cleaned = prompt

            .replace(/прочитай/i, "")

            .replace(/открой/i, "")

            .replace(/read/i, "")

            .replace(/open/i, "")

            .trim();

        return cleaned;

    }

}

<file path="server/src/modules/ai/prompt/IDEContextBuilder.ts">
export interface IDEPayload {

    activeFile: string;

    activeContent: string;

    openedFiles: string[];

}

export class IDEContextBuilder {

    public build(

        payload: IDEPayload,

    ): string {

        return [

            "===== ACTIVE FILE =====",

            payload.activeFile || "None",

            "",

            "===== OPEN FILES =====",

            payload.openedFiles.join("\n"),

            "",

            "===== FILE CONTENT =====",

            payload.activeContent,

        ].join("\n");

    }

}

import { IDEContextBuilder } from "./IDEContextBuilder.js";
import { WorkspaceContextBuilder } from "./WorkspaceContextBuilder.js";
import { SystemPromptBuilder } from "./SystemPromptBuilder.js";

export interface PromptRequest {

    prompt: string;

    activeFile: string;

    activeContent: string;

    openedFiles: string[];

    projectTree: unknown;

}

export class PromptBuilder {

    constructor(

        private readonly ide =

            new IDEContextBuilder(),

        private readonly workspace =

            new WorkspaceContextBuilder(),

        private readonly system =

            new SystemPromptBuilder(),

    ) {}

    public build(

        request: PromptRequest,

    ) {

        return {

            system:

                this.system.build(),

            prompt: [

                request.prompt,

                "",

                this.ide.build({

                    activeFile:

                        request.activeFile,

                    activeContent:

                        request.activeContent,

                    openedFiles:

                        request.openedFiles,

                }),

                "",

                this.workspace.build(

                    request.projectTree,

                ),

            ].join("\n\n"),

        };

    }

}

<file path="server/src/modules/ai/providers/AnthropicProvider.ts">
import type {
    AIProvider,
    AIProviderRequest,
    AIProviderResponse,
} from "../contracts/AIProvider.js";

export class AnthropicProvider implements AIProvider {

    public readonly name = "anthropic";

    constructor(
        private readonly apiKey: string,
        private readonly model: string = process.env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL || "claude-sonnet-4-6",
        private readonly baseUrl: string = process.env.ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL || "https://api.anthropic.com",
    ) {}

    public async ask(
        request: AIProviderRequest,
    ): Promise<AIProviderResponse> {
        if (!this.apiKey) {
            throw new Error(
                "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is not configured.",
            );
        }

        const tools =
            request.tools?.map(tool => ({
                name: tool.name,
                description: tool.description,
                input_schema:
                    tool.parameters ??
                    {
                        type: "object",
                        properties: {},
                    },
            }));

        const response =
            await fetch(
                `${this.baseUrl}/v1/messages`,
                {
                    method: "POST",
                    headers: {
                        "Content-Type": "application/json",
                        "x-api-key": this.apiKey,
                        "anthropic-version": "2023-06-01",
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        model: this.model,
                        max_tokens: Number(
                            process.env.ANTHROPIC_MAX_TOKENS ?? 4096,
                        ),
                        system: request.system,
                        messages: [
                            {
                                role: "user",
                                content: request.prompt,
                            },
                        ],
                        ...(tools && tools.length > 0
                            ? { tools }
                            : {}),
                    }),
                },
            );

        if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error(
                `Anthropic request failed: ${response.status} ${await response.text()}`,
            );
        }

        const data =
            await response.json() as {
                content?: Array<{
                    type?: string;
                    text?: string;
                    name?: string;
                    input?: Record<string, unknown>;
                }>;
            };

        const toolUse =
            (data.content ?? []).find(
                block =>
                    block.type === "tool_use" &&
                    block.name,
            );

        if (toolUse?.name) {
            const args =
                Object.fromEntries(
                    Object.entries(
                        toolUse.input ?? {},
                    ).map(
                        ([key, value]) => [
                            key,
                            typeof value === "string"
                                ? value
                                : JSON.stringify(value),
                        ],
                    ),
                );

            return {
                content: "",
                toolCall: {
                    tool: toolUse.name,
                    arguments: args,
                },
            };
        }

        const content =
            (data.content ?? [])
                .filter(
                    block => block.type === "text",
                )
                .map(
                    block => block.text ?? "",
                )
                .join("\n")
                .trim();

        return {
            content:
                content ||
                "The model returned an empty response.",
        };
    }
}
</file>

<file path="server/src/modules/ai/providers/MockProvider.ts">
import type {
    AIProvider,
    AIProviderRequest,
    AIProviderResponse,
} from "../contracts/AIProvider.js";

export class MockProvider implements AIProvider {

    public readonly name = "mock";

    public async ask(
        request: AIProviderRequest,
    ): Promise<AIProviderResponse> {
        const prompt = request.prompt;

        if (prompt.includes("===== TOOL RESULT =====")) {
            const toolResult =
                this.extractToolResult(prompt);

            return {
                content:
                    this.buildFinalAnswer(
                        toolResult,
                        prompt,
                    ),
            };
        }

        const userPrompt =
            this.extractUserPrompt(prompt);

        const lower =
            userPrompt.toLowerCase();

        if (
            this.canUseTool(request, "word_edit") &&
            lower.includes("word") &&
            (
                lower.includes("замени") ||
                lower.includes("измени") ||
                lower.includes("отредакт") ||
                lower.includes("replace")
            )
        ) {
            const parsed =
                this.extractWordEdit(userPrompt);

            if (parsed) {
                return {
                    content: "",
                    toolCall: {
                        tool: "word_edit",
                        arguments: parsed,
                    },
                };
            }
        }

        if (
            this.canUseTool(request, "edit_file") &&
            (
                lower.includes("замени") ||
                lower.includes("replace") ||
                lower.includes("измени файл") ||
                lower.includes("edit file")
            )
        ) {
            const parsed =
                this.extractLocalEdit(userPrompt);

            if (parsed) {
                return {
                    content: "",
                    toolCall: {
                        tool: "edit_file",
                        arguments: parsed,
                    },
                };
            }
        }

        if (
            this.canUseTool(request, "list_files") &&
            (
                lower.includes("покажи файлы") ||
                lower.includes("список файлов") ||
                lower.includes("list files") ||
                lower.includes("какие файлы")
            )
        ) {
            return {
                content: "",
                toolCall: {
                    tool: "list_files",
                    arguments: {
                        path: this.extractDirectory(
                            userPrompt,
                        ),
                    },
                },
            };
        }

        if (
            (
                this.canUseTool(request, "read_file") ||
                this.canUseTool(request, "word_read")
            ) &&
            (
                lower.includes("прочитай") ||
                lower.includes("прочитать") ||
                lower.includes("открой") ||
                lower.includes("открыть") ||
                lower.includes("read") ||
                lower.includes("open")
            )
        ) {
            const filePath =
                this.extractFilePath(
                    userPrompt,
                );

            if (!filePath) {
                return {
                    content:
                        "Укажи путь к файлу, который нужно прочитать.",
                };
            }

            const isWord =
                filePath.toLowerCase().endsWith(".docx");

            const tool =
                isWord &&
                this.canUseTool(request, "word_read")
                    ? "word_read"
                    : this.canUseTool(request, "read_file")
                        ? "read_file"
                        : "";

            if (!tool) {
                return {
                    content:
                        "The selected agent does not have a tool for this file.",
                };
            }

            return {
                content: "",
                toolCall: {
                    tool,
                    arguments: {
                        path: filePath,
                    },
                },
            };
        }

        return {
            content:
                `Mock AI response: ${userPrompt}`,
        };
    }

    private canUseTool(
        request: AIProviderRequest,
        name: string,
    ): boolean {
        return Boolean(
            request.tools?.some(
                tool => tool.name === name,
            ),
        );
    }

    private extractUserPrompt(
        prompt: string,
    ): string {
        const markers = [
            "===== ACTIVE FILE =====",
            "----- IDE Context -----",
        ];

        let result = prompt;

        for (const marker of markers) {
            const index = result.indexOf(marker);

            if (index !== -1) {
                result = result.slice(0, index);
                break;
            }
        }

        return result.trim();
    }

    private extractFilePath(
        prompt: string,
    ): string {
        const match =
            prompt.match(
                /(?:прочитай|прочитать|открой|открыть|read|open)\s+(?:файл\s+|the\s+)?(?:"([^"]+)"|'([^']+)'|`([^`]+)`|([^\s]+))/i,
            );

        if (!match) {
            return "";
        }

        return (
            match[1] ??
            match[2] ??
            match[3] ??
            match[4] ??
            ""
        ).trim();
    }

    private extractDirectory(
        prompt: string,
    ): string {
        const match =
            prompt.match(
                /(?:в папке|директории|directory|folder)\s+([^\s,]+)/i,
            );

        return match?.[1] ?? ".";
    }

    private extractLocalEdit(
        prompt: string,
    ): Record<string, string> | null {
        const pathMatch =
            prompt.match(
                /(?:файл|file)\s+(?:"([^"]+)"|'([^']+)'|`([^`]+)`|([^\s:,]+))/i,
            );

        const replaceMatch =
            prompt.match(
                /(?:замени|replace)\s+(?:"([^"]+)"|'([^']+)'|`([^`]+)`|(.+?))\s+(?:на|with|to)\s+(?:"([^"]+)"|'([^']+)'|`([^`]+)`|(.+))$/i,
            );

        if (!pathMatch || !replaceMatch) {
            return null;
        }

        return {
            path:
                pathMatch[1] ??
                pathMatch[2] ??
                pathMatch[3] ??
                pathMatch[4] ??
                "",
            find:
                replaceMatch[1] ??
                replaceMatch[2] ??
                replaceMatch[3] ??
                replaceMatch[4] ??
                "",
            replace:
                replaceMatch[5] ??
                replaceMatch[6] ??
                replaceMatch[7] ??
                replaceMatch[8] ??
                "",
        };
    }

    private extractWordEdit(
        prompt: string,
    ): Record<string, string> | null {
        const match =
            prompt.match(
                /(?:замени|replace)\s+(?:"([^"]+)"|'([^']+)'|`([^`]+)`)\s+(?:на|with|to)\s+(?:"([^"]+)"|'([^']+)'|`([^`]+)`)/i,
            );

        const pathMatch =
            prompt.match(
                /(?:word|документ|файл)\s+(?:"([^"]+)"|'([^']+)'|`([^`]+)`|([^\s]+\.docx))/i,
            );

        if (!match || !pathMatch) {
            return null;
        }

        const find =
            match[1] ?? match[2] ?? match[3] ?? "";
        const replace =
            match[4] ?? match[5] ?? match[6] ?? "";
        const path =
            pathMatch[1] ??
            pathMatch[2] ??
            pathMatch[3] ??
            pathMatch[4] ??
            "";

        return {
            path,
            find,
            replace,
            share: "true",
        };
    }

    private extractToolResult(
        prompt: string,
    ): string {
        const marker = "===== TOOL RESULT =====";
        const start = prompt.indexOf(marker);

        if (start === -1) {
            return "";
        }

        const contentStart =
            start + marker.length;

        const instructionMarker =
            "===== INSTRUCTION =====";

        const end =
            prompt.indexOf(
                instructionMarker,
                contentStart,
            );

        return (
            end === -1
                ? prompt.slice(contentStart)
                : prompt.slice(contentStart, end)
        ).trim();
    }

    private buildFinalAnswer(
        toolResult: string,
        prompt: string,
    ): string {
        if (!toolResult) {
            return "Инструмент не вернул результат.";
        }

        if (
            prompt.toLowerCase().includes("word") ||
            prompt.toLowerCase().includes("документ")
        ) {
            return toolResult;
        }

        const normalized =
            toolResult.trim();

        if (
            normalized.startsWith("# JustAI")
        ) {
            return [
                "Это проект JustAI.",
                "",
                "Это AI IDE, написанная на TypeScript.",
                "",
                "Для запуска требуется:",
                "- Node.js 22+",
                "- npm 11+",
            ].join("\n");
        }

        return [
            "Результат инструмента:",
            "",
            normalized,
        ].join("\n");
    }
}
</file>

<file path="server/src/modules/ai/providers/OpenAIProvider.ts">
import type {
    AIProvider,
    AIProviderRequest,
    AIProviderResponse,
} from "../contracts/AIProvider.js";

export class OpenAIProvider implements AIProvider {

    public readonly name = "openai";

    constructor(
        private readonly apiKey: string,
        private readonly model: string = process.env.OPENAI_MODEL || "gpt-5.6",
        private readonly baseUrl: string = process.env.OPENAI_BASE_URL || "https://api.openai.com/v1",
    ) {}

    public async ask(
        request: AIProviderRequest,
    ): Promise<AIProviderResponse> {
        if (!this.apiKey) {
            throw new Error(
                "OPENAI_API_KEY is not configured.",
            );
        }

        const tools =
            request.tools?.map(tool => ({
                type: "function" as const,
                name: tool.name,
                description: tool.description,
                parameters:
                    tool.parameters ??
                    {
                        type: "object",
                        properties: {},
                    },
            }));

        const response =
            await fetch(
                `${this.baseUrl}/responses`,
                {
                    method: "POST",
                    headers: {
                        "Content-Type": "application/json",
                        Authorization: `Bearer ${this.apiKey}`,
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        model: this.model,
                        instructions: request.system,
                        input: [
                            {
                                role: "user",
                                content: request.prompt,
                            },
                        ],
                        ...(tools && tools.length > 0
                            ? { tools }
                            : {}),
                    }),
                },
            );

        if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error(
                `OpenAI request failed: ${response.status} ${await response.text()}`,
            );
        }

        const data =
            await response.json() as {
                output?: Array<{
                    type?: string;
                    name?: string;
                    arguments?: string;
                    content?: Array<{
                        type?: string;
                        text?: string;
                    }>;
                }>;
            };

        const output =
            data.output ?? [];

        const functionCall =
            output.find(
                item =>
                    item.type === "function_call" &&
                    item.name,
            );

        if (functionCall?.name) {
            let args: Record<string, string> = {};

            if (functionCall.arguments) {
                try {
                    const parsed =
                        JSON.parse(
                            functionCall.arguments,
                        ) as Record<string, unknown>;

                    args = Object.fromEntries(
                        Object.entries(parsed).map(
                            ([key, value]) => [
                                key,
                                typeof value === "string"
                                    ? value
                                    : JSON.stringify(value),
                            ],
                        ),
                    );
                }
                catch {
                    throw new Error(
                        "OpenAI returned invalid tool arguments.",
                    );
                }
            }

            return {
                content: "",
                toolCall: {
                    tool: functionCall.name,
                    arguments: args,
                },
            };
        }

        const content =
            output
                .filter(
                    item => item.type === "message",
                )
                .flatMap(
                    item => item.content ?? [],
                )
                .filter(
                    item => item.type === "output_text",
                )
                .map(
                    item => item.text ?? "",
                )
                .join("\n")
                .trim();

        return {
            content:
                content ||
                "The model returned an empty response.",
        };
    }
}

<file path="server/src/modules/ai/providers/ProviderFactory.ts">
import { MockProvider } from "./MockProvider.js";
import { OpenAIProvider } from "./OpenAIProvider.js";
import { AnthropicProvider } from "./AnthropicProvider.js";

import type {
    AIProvider,
} from "../contracts/AIProvider.js";

export interface ProviderInfo {
    id: string;
    label: string;
    configured: boolean;
    model: string;
}

export class ProviderFactory {

    public create(
        provider: string,
    ): AIProvider {
        switch (provider.toLowerCase()) {
            case "mock":
                return new MockProvider();

            case "openai":
                return new OpenAIProvider(
                    process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY ?? "",
                );

            case "anthropic":
                return new AnthropicProvider(
                    process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY ?? "",
                );

            default:
                throw new Error(
                    `Unknown AI provider: ${provider}`,
                );
        }
    }

    public list(): ProviderInfo[] {
        return [
            {
                id: "mock",
                label: "Mock",
                configured: true,
                model: "local",
            },
            {
                id: "openai",
                label: "OpenAI",
                configured: Boolean(process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY),
                model:
                    process.env.OPENAI_MODEL ??
                    "gpt-5.6",
            },
            {
                id: "anthropic",
                label: "Anthropic",
                configured: Boolean(process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY),
                model:
                    process.env.ANTHROPIC_MODEL ??
                    "claude-sonnet-4-6",
            },
        ];
    }
}

export interface ToolResult {

    success: boolean;

    content: string;

}

export interface AITool {

    readonly name: string;

    readonly description: string;

    readonly parameters?: Record<string, unknown>;

    execute(

        args: Record<string, string>,

    ): Promise<ToolResult>;

}

<file path="server/src/modules/ai/tools/EditFileTool.ts">
import { promises as fs } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

import type {
    AITool,
    ToolResult,
} from "./AITool.js";

export class EditFileTool implements AITool {

    public readonly name = "edit_file";

    public readonly description =
        "Replaces an exact text fragment in a UTF-8 workspace file. Use only when the user asks to change a local file.";

    public readonly parameters = {
        type: "object",
        properties: {
            path: {
                type: "string",
                description: "Workspace-relative file path.",
            },
            find: {
                type: "string",
                description: "Exact text to replace.",
            },
            replace: {
                type: "string",
                description: "Replacement text.",
            },
        },
        required: ["path", "find", "replace"],
        additionalProperties: false,
    };

    constructor(
        private readonly workspaceRoot: string,
    ) {}

    public async execute(
        args: Record<string, string>,
    ): Promise<ToolResult> {

        const file = args.path;
        const find = args.find;
        const replace = args.replace;

        if (!file || find === undefined || replace === undefined) {
            return {
                success: false,
                content: "Required arguments: path, find, replace.",
            };
        }

        try {
            const absolute = path.resolve(this.workspaceRoot, file);
            const relative = path.relative(this.workspaceRoot, absolute);

            if (relative.startsWith("..") || path.isAbsolute(relative)) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    content: "Access denied: file is outside workspace.",
                };
            }

            const current = await fs.readFile(absolute, "utf8");

            if (!current.includes(find)) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    content: "The exact text to replace was not found.",
                };
            }

            const occurrences = current.split(find).length - 1;

            if (occurrences > 1) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    content: `The text occurs ${occurrences} times. Refuse to make an ambiguous edit; provide a more specific fragment.`,
                };
            }

            const updated = current.replace(find, replace);
            await fs.writeFile(absolute, updated, "utf8");

            return {
                success: true,
                content: `Updated ${file}. Exactly one occurrence was replaced.`,
            };
        }
        catch (error) {
            return {
                success: false,
                content: String(error),
            };
        }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="server/src/modules/ai/tools/ListFilesTool.ts">
import { promises as fs } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

import type {
    AITool,
    ToolResult,
} from "./AITool.js";

export class ListFilesTool implements AITool {

    public readonly name = "list_files";

    public readonly description =
        "Lists files and directories inside the local workspace.";

    public readonly parameters = {
        type: "object",
        properties: {
            path: {
                type: "string",
                description: "Workspace-relative directory path. Defaults to '.'.",
            },
        },
        additionalProperties: false,
    };

    constructor(
        private readonly workspaceRoot: string,
    ) {}

    public async execute(
        args: Record<string, string>,
    ): Promise<ToolResult> {

        const requestedPath = args.path || ".";

        try {
            const absolute = path.resolve(this.workspaceRoot, requestedPath);
            const relative = path.relative(this.workspaceRoot, absolute);

            if (relative.startsWith("..") || path.isAbsolute(relative)) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    content: "Access denied: path is outside workspace.",
                };
            }

            const entries = await fs.readdir(absolute, { withFileTypes: true });

            const result = entries
                .sort((a, b) => {
                    if (a.isDirectory() !== b.isDirectory()) {
                        return a.isDirectory() ? -1 : 1;
                    }
                    return a.name.localeCompare(b.name, "ru", {
                        numeric: true,
                        sensitivity: "base",
                    });
                })
                .map(entry =>
                    `${entry.isDirectory() ? "[DIR] " : "[FILE] "}${entry.name}`,
                );

            return {
                success: true,
                content: result.join("\n") || "(empty directory)",
            };
        }
        catch (error) {
            return {
                success: false,
                content: String(error),
            };
        }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="server/src/modules/ai/tools/ReadFileTool.ts">
import { promises as fs } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";

import type {
    AITool,
    ToolResult,
} from "./AITool.js";

export class ReadFileTool implements AITool {

    public readonly name = "read_file";

    public readonly description =
        "Reads a UTF-8 text file from the local workspace.";

    public readonly parameters = {
        type: "object",
        properties: {
            path: {
                type: "string",
                description: "Workspace-relative file path.",
            },
        },
        required: ["path"],
        additionalProperties: false,
    };

    constructor(
        private readonly workspaceRoot: string,
    ) {}

    public async execute(
        args: Record<string, string>,
    ): Promise<ToolResult> {

        const file = args.path;

        if (!file) {
            return {
                success: false,
                content: "Missing required argument: path",
            };
        }

        try {
            const absolute = path.resolve(this.workspaceRoot, file);
            const relative = path.relative(this.workspaceRoot, absolute);

            if (relative.startsWith("..") || path.isAbsolute(relative)) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    content: "Access denied: file is outside workspace.",
                };
            }

            const content = await fs.readFile(absolute, "utf8");

            return {
                success: true,
                content,
            };
        }
        catch (error) {
            return {
                success: false,
                content: String(error),
            };
        }
    }
}

<file path="server/src/modules/ai/tools/ToolCall.ts">
export interface ToolCall {

    tool: string;

    arguments: Record<string, string>;

}
</file>

<file path="server/src/modules/ai/tools/ToolExecutor.ts">
import { ToolRegistry } from "./ToolRegistry.js";

import type { ToolCall } from "./ToolCall.js";

export class ToolExecutor {

    constructor(

        private readonly registry: ToolRegistry,

    ) {}

    public async execute(

        call: ToolCall,

    ): Promise<string> {

        const tool =

            this.registry.get(

                call.tool,

            );

        if (!tool) {

            throw new Error(

                `Tool '${call.tool}' not found.`,

            );

        }

        const result =

            await tool.execute(

                call.arguments,

            );

        return result.content;

    }

}

import type { AITool } from "./AITool.js";
import type { ToolDefinition } from "../contracts/ToolDefinition.js";

export class ToolRegistry {

    private readonly tools =
        new Map<string, AITool>();

    public register(
        tool: AITool,
    ): void {
        this.tools.set(tool.name, tool);
    }

    public get(
        name: string,
    ): AITool | undefined {
        return this.tools.get(name);
    }

    public list(): AITool[] {
        return [...this.tools.values()];
    }

    public definitions(): ToolDefinition[] {
        return this.list().map(tool => ({
            name: tool.name,
            description: tool.description,
            parameters: tool.parameters,
        }));
    }
}

<file path="server/src/modules/ai/validators/ChatRequestValidator.ts">
import {
    Validator,
    ValidationResult,
} from '../../../core/validation/index.js';

import { ChatRequestDto } from '../dto/ChatRequestDto.js';

export class ChatRequestValidator
    extends Validator<ChatRequestDto> {

    public validate(
        data: unknown,
    ): ValidationResult<ChatRequestDto> {

        if (
            typeof data !== 'object' ||
            data === null
        ) {
            return this.failure(
                'Request body must be an object.',
            );
        }

        const dto =
            data as Partial<ChatRequestDto>;

        const message =
            this.requiredString(
                dto.message,
                'message',
            );

        if (!message.success) {
            return this.failure(
                message.message!,
            );
        }

        if (
            dto.context === undefined
        ) {
            return this.success({
                message: message.value!,
            });
        }

        if (
            typeof dto.context !== 'object' ||
            dto.context === null
        ) {
            return this.failure(
                'Field "context" must be an object.',
            );
        }

        const context = dto.context as {
            path?: unknown;
            content?: unknown;
        };

        if (
            context.path !== undefined &&
            typeof context.path !== 'string'
        ) {
            return this.failure(
                'Field "context.path" must be a string.',
            );
        }

        if (
            context.content !== undefined &&
            typeof context.content !== 'string'
        ) {
            return this.failure(
                'Field "context.content" must be a string.',
            );
        }

        return this.success({
            message: message.value!,
            context: {
                path:
                    context.path as
                        | string
                        | undefined,
                content:
                    context.content as
                        | string
                        | undefined,
            },
        });

    }

}

<file path="server/src/modules/ai/AIController.ts">
import type { NextFunction, Request, Response } from "express";

import { AIService } from "./AIService.js";
import { ProviderFactory } from "./providers/ProviderFactory.js";
import { AgentProfileService } from "./agents/AgentProfileService.js";
import {
    BrowserCouncilService,
    type CouncilProviderId,
    type CouncilRunRequest,
} from "./council/index.js";

import type { AIChatRequest } from "./contracts/AIChatRequest.js";

export class AIController {
    constructor(
        private readonly aiService: AIService,
        private readonly providerFactory: ProviderFactory,
        private readonly profiles: AgentProfileService,
        private readonly browserCouncil: BrowserCouncilService,
    ) {}

    public agents = (_req: Request, res: Response): void => {
        res.json({ agents: this.profiles.list() });
    };

    public chat = async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
        try {
            const request = req.body as AIChatRequest;
            if (!request.prompt?.trim()) {
                res.status(400).json({ error: "Prompt is required." });
                return;
            }
            res.json(await this.aiService.chat(request));
        } catch (error) {
            next(error);
        }
    };

    public providers = (_req: Request, res: Response): void => {
        res.json({ providers: this.providerFactory.list() });
    };

    public councilStatus = async (_req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
        try {
            res.json({ providers: await this.browserCouncil.status() });
        } catch (error) {
            next(error);
        }
    };

    public councilConnect = async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
        try {
            res.json(await this.browserCouncil.connect(req.params.provider as CouncilProviderId));
        } catch (error) {
            next(error);
        }
    };

    public councilRun = async (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction): Promise<void> => {
        try {
            const request = req.body as CouncilRunRequest;
            res.json(await this.browserCouncil.run(request));
        } catch (error) {
            next(error);
        }
    };
}

import { Router } from "express";
import type { AIController } from "./AIController.js";

export function createAIRouter(controller: AIController): Router {
    const router = Router();

    router.get("/providers", controller.providers);
    router.get("/agents", controller.agents);
    router.post("/chat", controller.chat);

    router.get("/council/status", controller.councilStatus);
    router.post("/council/connect/:provider", controller.councilConnect);
    router.post("/council/run", controller.councilRun);

    return router;
}

<file path="server/src/modules/ai/AIService.ts">
import { ContextService } from "./context/ContextService.js";

import type { AIChatRequest } from "./contracts/AIChatRequest.js";
import type { AIChatResponse } from "./contracts/AIChatResponse.js";
import type { AIProvider } from "./contracts/AIProvider.js";

import { PromptBuilder } from "./prompt/PromptBuilder.js";
import { ToolRegistry } from "./tools/ToolRegistry.js";
import { Agent } from "./agent/Agent.js";
import { ProviderFactory } from "./providers/ProviderFactory.js";
import { AgentProfileService } from "./agents/AgentProfileService.js";

export class AIService {

    constructor(
        private readonly provider: AIProvider,
        private readonly providerFactory: ProviderFactory,
        private readonly contextService: ContextService,
        private readonly toolRegistry: ToolRegistry,
        private readonly promptBuilder: PromptBuilder,
        private readonly agent: Agent,
        private readonly profiles: AgentProfileService,
    ) {}

    public async chat(
        request: AIChatRequest,
    ): Promise<AIChatResponse> {

        const context =
            await this.contextService.buildContext();

        const built =
            this.promptBuilder.build({
                prompt: request.prompt,
                activeFile: request.activeFile ?? "",
                activeContent: request.activeContent ?? "",
                openedFiles: request.openedFiles ?? [],
                projectTree: request.projectTree ?? [],
            });

        const provider =
            request.provider
                ? this.providerFactory.create(
                    request.provider,
                )
                : this.provider;

        const profile =
            this.profiles.get(
                request.agent,
            );

        const tools =
            this.toolRegistry
                .definitions()
                .filter(
                    tool =>
                        profile.tools.includes(
                            tool.name,
                        ),
                );

        const system =
            [
                built.system,
                "",
                "===== AGENT PROFILE =====",
                profile.systemInstruction,
            ].join("\n");

        let prompt =
            built.prompt;

        const maxIterations =
            Math.min(
                Math.max(
                    Number(
                        process.env.JUSTAI_MAX_AGENT_STEPS ??
                        8,
                    ),
                    1,
                ),
                12,
            );

        for (
            let step = 0;
            step < maxIterations;
            step += 1
        ) {

            const response =
                await provider.ask({
                    prompt,
                    system,
                    context: JSON.stringify(
                        context,
                        null,
                        2,
                    ),
                    tools,
                });

            if (!response.toolCall) {
                return {
                    answer: response.content,
                };
            }

            const toolResult =
                await this.agent.executeToolCall(
                    response.toolCall,
                );

            prompt =
                [
                    prompt,
                    "",
                    "===== TOOL CALL =====",
                    JSON.stringify(
                        response.toolCall,
                        null,
                        2,
                    ),
                    "",
                    "===== TOOL RESULT =====",
                    toolResult,
                    "",
                    "===== INSTRUCTION =====",
                    "Use the tool result to continue the user's task. If another tool is needed, call it. Otherwise return the final answer to the user.",
                ].join("\n");
        }

        return {
            answer:
                "Agent stopped because the maximum number of tool steps was reached. Please narrow the task or try again.",
        };
    }
}
</file>

<file path="server/src/modules/integrations/microsoft/MicrosoftGraphService.ts">
import { DocxDocument } from "./ZipDocument.js";
import { MicrosoftOAuthService } from "./MicrosoftOAuthService.js";

interface GraphDriveItem {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    size?: number;
    webUrl?: string;
    "@microsoft.graph.downloadUrl"?: string;
}

export class MicrosoftGraphService {

    constructor(
        private readonly oauth: MicrosoftOAuthService,
    ) {}

    private async request(
        url: string,
        init: RequestInit = {},
    ): Promise<Response> {
        const token =
            await this.oauth.getAccessToken();

        const headers = new Headers(
            init.headers,
        );

        headers.set(
            "Authorization",
            `Bearer ${token}`,
        );

        return fetch(
            url,
            {
                ...init,
                headers,
            },
        );
    }

    public async getItem(
        itemPath: string,
    ): Promise<GraphDriveItem> {
        const normalized =
            itemPath
                .replace(/^\/+/, "")
                .replace(/\/+$/, "");

        const encodedPath =
            normalized
                .split("/")
                .map(part => encodeURIComponent(part))
                .join("/");

        const response =
            await this.request(
                `https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/drive/root:/${encodedPath}`,
            );

        if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error(
                `Microsoft Graph item lookup failed: ${response.status} ${await response.text()}`,
            );
        }

        return response.json() as Promise<GraphDriveItem>;
    }

    public async download(
        itemPath: string,
    ): Promise<Buffer> {
        const item =
            await this.getItem(
                itemPath,
            );

        if (item["@microsoft.graph.downloadUrl"]) {
            const response =
                await fetch(
                    item["@microsoft.graph.downloadUrl"],
                );

            if (!response.ok) {
                throw new Error(
                    `Microsoft file download failed: ${response.status}`,
                );
            }

            return Buffer.from(
                await response.arrayBuffer(),
            );
        }

        const response =
            await this.request(
                `https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/drive/items/${encodeURIComponent(item.id)}/content`,
            );

        if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error(
                `Microsoft file download failed: ${response.status} ${await response.text()}`,
            );
        }

        return Buffer.from(
            await response.arrayBuffer(),
        );
    }

    public async replaceContent(
        itemId: string,
        content: Buffer,
    ): Promise<GraphDriveItem> {
        const response =
            await this.request(
                `https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/drive/items/${encodeURIComponent(itemId)}/content`,
                {
                    method: "PUT",
                    headers: {
                        "Content-Type":
                            "application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document",
                    },
                    body: content as unknown as BodyInit,
                },
            );

        if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error(
                `Microsoft file upload failed: ${response.status} ${await response.text()}`,
            );
        }

        return response.json() as Promise<GraphDriveItem>;
    }

    public async replaceWordText(
        itemPath: string,
        find: string,
        replace: string,
    ): Promise<{
        item: GraphDriveItem;
        replacements: number;
    }> {
        if (!itemPath.toLowerCase().endsWith(".docx")) {
            throw new Error(
                "word_edit requires a .docx Word document.",
            );
        }

        const item =
            await this.getItem(itemPath);

        const archive =
            await this.download(itemPath);

        const document =
            new DocxDocument(archive);

        const result =
            document.replaceText(
                find,
                replace,
            );

        const updated =
            await this.replaceContent(
                item.id,
                result.archive,
            );

        return {
            item: updated,
            replacements:
                result.replacements,
        };
    }

    public async readWordText(
        itemPath: string,
    ): Promise<{
        item: GraphDriveItem;
        text: string;
    }> {
        if (!itemPath.toLowerCase().endsWith(".docx")) {
            throw new Error(
                "word_read requires a .docx Word document.",
            );
        }

        const item =
            await this.getItem(itemPath);

        const archive =
            await this.download(itemPath);

        const document =
            new DocxDocument(archive);

        return {
            item,
            text: document.getText(),
        };
    }

    public async createEditLink(
        itemId: string,
        scope:
            | "anonymous"
            | "organization" = "organization",
    ): Promise<string | null> {
        const response =
            await this.request(
                `https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me/drive/items/${encodeURIComponent(itemId)}/createLink`,
                {
                    method: "POST",
                    headers: {
                        "Content-Type": "application/json",
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        type: "edit",
                        scope,
                    }),
                },
            );

        if (!response.ok) {
            return null;
        }

        const data =
            await response.json() as {
                link?: {
                    webUrl?: string;
                };
            };

        return data.link?.webUrl ?? null;
    }
}
</file>

<file path="server/src/modules/integrations/microsoft/MicrosoftOAuthService.ts">
import crypto from "node:crypto";
import type { MicrosoftTokenStore } from "./MicrosoftTokenStore.js";
import type { StoredToken } from "./MicrosoftTokenStore.js";

interface MicrosoftOAuthConfig {
    clientId: string;
    clientSecret: string;
    tenant: string;
    redirectUri: string;
}

export class MicrosoftOAuthService {

    private readonly stateStore =
        new Map<string, number>();

    constructor(
        private readonly config: MicrosoftOAuthConfig,
        private readonly tokenStore: MicrosoftTokenStore,
    ) {}

    public isConfigured(): boolean {
        return Boolean(
            this.config.clientId &&
            this.config.clientSecret &&
            this.config.redirectUri,
        );
    }

    public createAuthorizationUrl(): string {
        if (!this.isConfigured()) {
            throw new Error(
                "Microsoft OAuth is not configured. Set MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID, MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET and MICROSOFT_REDIRECT_URI.",
            );
        }

        const state =
            crypto.randomBytes(24).toString("hex");

        this.stateStore.set(
            state,
            Date.now() + 10 * 60 * 1000,
        );

        const params = new URLSearchParams({
            client_id: this.config.clientId,
            response_type: "code",
            redirect_uri: this.config.redirectUri,
            response_mode: "query",
            scope: [
                "openid",
                "profile",
                "offline_access",
                "User.Read",
                "Files.ReadWrite",
            ].join(" "),
            state,
        });

        return `https://login.microsoftonline.com/${encodeURIComponent(this.config.tenant)}/oauth2/v2.0/authorize?${params.toString()}`;
    }

    public async handleCallback(
        code: string,
        state: string,
    ): Promise<void> {
        const expires =
            this.stateStore.get(state);

        this.stateStore.delete(state);

        if (!expires || expires < Date.now()) {
            throw new Error("Microsoft OAuth state is invalid or expired.");
        }

        const tokenResponse =
            await fetch(
                `https://login.microsoftonline.com/${encodeURIComponent(this.config.tenant)}/oauth2/v2.0/token`,
                {
                    method: "POST",
                    headers: {
                        "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded",
                    },
                    body: new URLSearchParams({
                        client_id: this.config.clientId,
                        client_secret: this.config.clientSecret,
                        grant_type: "authorization_code",
                        code,
                        redirect_uri: this.config.redirectUri,
                        scope: [
                            "openid",
                            "profile",
                            "offline_access",
                            "User.Read",
                            "Files.ReadWrite",
                        ].join(" "),
                    }),
                },
            );

        if (!tokenResponse.ok) {
            throw new Error(
                `Microsoft token exchange failed: ${await tokenResponse.text()}`,
            );
        }

        const data =
            await tokenResponse.json() as {
                access_token: string;
                refresh_token?: string;
                expires_in?: number;
            };

        if (!data.access_token || !data.refresh_token) {
            throw new Error(
                "Microsoft did not return the access/refresh token required by JustAI.",
            );
        }

        await this.tokenStore.save({
            accessToken: data.access_token,
            refreshToken: data.refresh_token,
            expiresAt:
                Date.now() +
                Math.max(
                    60,
                    data.expires_in ?? 3600,
                ) *
                1000,
        });
    }

    public async getAccessToken(): Promise<string> {
        const stored =
            await this.tokenStore.load();

        if (!stored) {
            throw new Error(
                "Microsoft account is not connected.",
            );
        }

        if (stored.expiresAt > Date.now() + 60_000) {
            return stored.accessToken;
        }

        const response =
            await fetch(
                `https://login.microsoftonline.com/${encodeURIComponent(this.config.tenant)}/oauth2/v2.0/token`,
                {
                    method: "POST",
                    headers: {
                        "Content-Type": "application/x-www-form-urlencoded",
                    },
                    body: new URLSearchParams({
                        client_id: this.config.clientId,
                        client_secret: this.config.clientSecret,
                        grant_type: "refresh_token",
                        refresh_token: stored.refreshToken,
                        scope: [
                            "openid",
                            "profile",
                            "offline_access",
                            "User.Read",
                            "Files.ReadWrite",
                        ].join(" "),
                    }),
                },
            );

        if (!response.ok) {
            throw new Error(
                `Microsoft token refresh failed: ${await response.text()}`,
            );
        }

        const data =
            await response.json() as {
                access_token: string;
                refresh_token?: string;
                expires_in?: number;
            };

        const next: StoredToken = {
            accessToken: data.access_token,
            refreshToken:
                data.refresh_token ??
                stored.refreshToken,
            expiresAt:
                Date.now() +
                Math.max(
                    60,
                    data.expires_in ?? 3600,
                ) *
                1000,
        };

        await this.tokenStore.save(next);

        return next.accessToken;
    }

    public async status(): Promise<{
        configured: boolean;
        connected: boolean;
    }> {
        return {
            configured: this.isConfigured(),
            connected: Boolean(await this.tokenStore.load()),
        };
    }

    public async disconnect(): Promise<void> {
        await this.tokenStore.clear();
    }
}
</file>

<file path="server/src/modules/integrations/microsoft/MicrosoftTokenStore.ts">
import { promises as fs } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import {
    createCipheriv,
    createDecipheriv,
    createHash,
    randomBytes,
} from "node:crypto";

interface StoredToken {
    accessToken: string;
    refreshToken: string;
    expiresAt: number;
    account?: string;
}

export class MicrosoftTokenStore {

    private readonly filePath: string;
    private readonly key: Buffer;

    constructor(
        workspaceRoot: string,
    ) {
        this.filePath = path.join(
            workspaceRoot,
            ".justai",
            "microsoft-token.json",
        );

        const secret =
            process.env.JUSTAI_ENCRYPTION_KEY ||
            "development-only-change-this-secret";

        this.key =
            createHash("sha256")
                .update(secret)
                .digest();
    }

    public async save(token: StoredToken): Promise<void> {
        await fs.mkdir(
            path.dirname(this.filePath),
            { recursive: true },
        );

        const iv = randomBytes(12);
        const cipher = createCipheriv(
            "aes-256-gcm",
            this.key,
            iv,
        );

        const plaintext = Buffer.from(
            JSON.stringify(token),
            "utf8",
        );

        const encrypted = Buffer.concat([
            cipher.update(plaintext),
            cipher.final(),
        ]);

        const tag = cipher.getAuthTag();

        await fs.writeFile(
            this.filePath,
            JSON.stringify({
                iv: iv.toString("base64"),
                tag: tag.toString("base64"),
                data: encrypted.toString("base64"),
            }),
            "utf8",
        );
    }

    public async load(): Promise<StoredToken | null> {
        try {
            const raw = await fs.readFile(
                this.filePath,
                "utf8",
            );

            const record = JSON.parse(raw) as {
                iv: string;
                tag: string;
                data: string;
            };

            const decipher = createDecipheriv(
                "aes-256-gcm",
                this.key,
                Buffer.from(record.iv, "base64"),
            );

            decipher.setAuthTag(
                Buffer.from(record.tag, "base64"),
            );

            const plaintext = Buffer.concat([
                decipher.update(
                    Buffer.from(record.data, "base64"),
                ),
                decipher.final(),
            ]);

            return JSON.parse(
                plaintext.toString("utf8"),
            ) as StoredToken;
        }
        catch {
            return null;
        }
    }

    public async clear(): Promise<void> {
        await fs.rm(
            this.filePath,
            { force: true },
        );
    }
}

export type { StoredToken };
</file>

<file path="server/src/modules/integrations/microsoft/WordEditTool.ts">
import type {
    AITool,
    ToolResult,
} from "../../ai/tools/AITool.js";

import { MicrosoftGraphService } from "./MicrosoftGraphService.js";

export class WordEditTool implements AITool {

    public readonly name = "word_edit";

    public readonly description =
        "Edits text inside a .docx Microsoft Word document stored in the connected OneDrive. Use only when the user explicitly asks to change a Word document.";

    public readonly parameters = {
        type: "object",
        properties: {
            path: {
                type: "string",
                description: "Path of the .docx file inside the connected OneDrive.",
            },
            find: {
                type: "string",
                description: "Exact text currently present in the Word document.",
            },
            replace: {
                type: "string",
                description: "New text.",
            },
            share: {
                type: "string",
                enum: ["true", "false"],
                description: "Return an edit link when possible.",
            },
        },
        required: ["path", "find", "replace"],
        additionalProperties: false,
    };

    constructor(
        private readonly graph: MicrosoftGraphService,
    ) {}

    public async execute(
        args: Record<string, string>,
    ): Promise<ToolResult> {
        try {
            const result =
                await this.graph.replaceWordText(
                    args.path ?? "",
                    args.find ?? "",
                    args.replace ?? "",
                );

            let link =
                result.item.webUrl ?? null;

            if (
                args.share === "true" ||
                !link
            ) {
                link =
                    await this.graph.createEditLink(
                        result.item.id,
                    ) ??
                    link;
            }

            return {
                success: true,
                content: [
                    `Word document updated: ${result.item.name}`,
                    `Replacements: ${result.replacements}`,
                    link
                        ? `Open in Word/OneDrive: ${link}`
                        : "The document was updated, but a sharing link could not be created.",
                ].join("\n"),
            };
        }
        catch (error) {
            return {
                success: false,
                content: String(error),
            };
        }
    }
}
