<file path="server/src/modules/integrations/microsoft/WordReadTool.ts">
import type {
    AITool,
    ToolResult,
} from "../../ai/tools/AITool.js";

import { MicrosoftGraphService } from "./MicrosoftGraphService.js";

export class WordReadTool implements AITool {

    public readonly name = "word_read";

    public readonly description =
        "Reads text from a .docx Microsoft Word document stored in the connected OneDrive.";

    public readonly parameters = {
        type: "object",
        properties: {
            path: {
                type: "string",
                description: "Path of the .docx file inside the connected OneDrive.",
            },
        },
        required: ["path"],
        additionalProperties: false,
    };

    constructor(
        private readonly graph: MicrosoftGraphService,
    ) {}

    public async execute(
        args: Record<string, string>,
    ): Promise<ToolResult> {
        try {
            const result =
                await this.graph.readWordText(
                    args.path ?? "",
                );

            return {
                success: true,
                content: [
                    `Word document: ${result.item.name}`,
                    "",
                    result.text,
                    "",
                    result.item.webUrl
                        ? `Open in Word/OneDrive: ${result.item.webUrl}`
                        : "",
                ].filter(Boolean).join("\n"),
            };
        }
        catch (error) {
            return {
                success: false,
                content: String(error),
            };
        }
    }
}
</file>

<file path="server/src/modules/integrations/microsoft/ZipDocument.ts">
import { deflateRawSync, inflateRawSync } from "node:zlib";

interface ZipEntry {
    name: string;
    method: number;
    flags: number;
    crc: number;
    compressed: Buffer;
    uncompressedSize: number;
    versionMadeBy: number;
    versionNeeded: number;
    externalAttributes: number;
}

function readUInt16(buffer: Buffer, offset: number): number {
    return buffer.readUInt16LE(offset);
}

function readUInt32(buffer: Buffer, offset: number): number {
    return buffer.readUInt32LE(offset);
}

function findEndOfCentralDirectory(buffer: Buffer): number {
    for (let i = buffer.length - 22; i >= Math.max(0, buffer.length - 65557); i -= 1) {
        if (readUInt32(buffer, i) === 0x06054b50) {
            return i;
        }
    }
    throw new Error("Invalid ZIP: end of central directory was not found.");
}

function parseZip(buffer: Buffer): ZipEntry[] {
    const eocd = findEndOfCentralDirectory(buffer);
    const count = readUInt16(buffer, eocd + 10);
    const centralOffset = readUInt32(buffer, eocd + 16);

    const entries: ZipEntry[] = [];
    let cursor = centralOffset;

    for (let i = 0; i < count; i += 1) {
        if (readUInt32(buffer, cursor) !== 0x02014b50) {
            throw new Error("Invalid ZIP: central directory entry is malformed.");
        }

        const versionMadeBy = readUInt16(buffer, cursor + 4);
        const versionNeeded = readUInt16(buffer, cursor + 6);
        const flags = readUInt16(buffer, cursor + 8);
        const method = readUInt16(buffer, cursor + 10);
        const crc = readUInt32(buffer, cursor + 16);
        const compressedSize = readUInt32(buffer, cursor + 20);
        const uncompressedSize = readUInt32(buffer, cursor + 24);
        const nameLength = readUInt16(buffer, cursor + 28);
        const extraLength = readUInt16(buffer, cursor + 30);
        const commentLength = readUInt16(buffer, cursor + 32);
        const externalAttributes = readUInt32(buffer, cursor + 38);
        const localOffset = readUInt32(buffer, cursor + 42);

        if (compressedSize === 0xffffffff || uncompressedSize === 0xffffffff || localOffset === 0xffffffff) {
            throw new Error("ZIP64 DOCX files are not supported by the built-in editor.");
        }

        const name = buffer.subarray(
            cursor + 46,
            cursor + 46 + nameLength,
        ).toString("utf8");

        if (readUInt32(buffer, localOffset) !== 0x04034b50) {
            throw new Error(`Invalid ZIP local header for ${name}.`);
        }

        const localNameLength = readUInt16(buffer, localOffset + 26);
        const localExtraLength = readUInt16(buffer, localOffset + 28);
        const dataStart =
            localOffset +
            30 +
            localNameLength +
            localExtraLength;

        const compressed = Buffer.from(
            buffer.subarray(
                dataStart,
                dataStart + compressedSize,
            ),
        );

        entries.push({
            name,
            method,
            flags,
            crc,
            compressed,
            uncompressedSize,
            versionMadeBy,
            versionNeeded,
            externalAttributes,
        });

        cursor += 46 + nameLength + extraLength + commentLength;
    }

    return entries;
}

function entryContent(entry: ZipEntry): Buffer {
    if (entry.method === 0) {
        return Buffer.from(entry.compressed);
    }

    if (entry.method === 8) {
        return inflateRawSync(entry.compressed);
    }

    throw new Error(`Unsupported ZIP compression method ${entry.method} for ${entry.name}.`);
}

function xmlEscape(value: string): string {
    return value
        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
        .replace(/'/g, "&apos;");
}

function xmlDecode(value: string): string {
    return value
        .replace(/&lt;/g, "<")
        .replace(/&gt;/g, ">")
        .replace(/&quot;/g, '"')
        .replace(/&apos;/g, "'")
        .replace(/&amp;/g, "&");
}

function crc32(buffer: Buffer): number {
    let crc = 0xffffffff;

    for (const byte of buffer) {
        crc ^= byte;
        for (let bit = 0; bit < 8; bit += 1) {
            const mask = -(crc & 1);
            crc = (crc >>> 1) ^ (0xedb88320 & mask);
        }
    }

    return (crc ^ 0xffffffff) >>> 0;
}

function makeLocalHeader(entry: ZipEntry, compressedSize: number, uncompressedSize: number, crc: number): Buffer {
    const name = Buffer.from(entry.name, "utf8");
    const header = Buffer.alloc(30 + name.length);

    header.writeUInt32LE(0x04034b50, 0);
    header.writeUInt16LE(entry.versionNeeded, 4);
    header.writeUInt16LE(entry.flags & ~0x0008, 6);
    header.writeUInt16LE(entry.method, 8);
    header.writeUInt16LE(0, 10);
    header.writeUInt16LE(0, 12);
    header.writeUInt32LE(crc, 14);
    header.writeUInt32LE(compressedSize, 18);
    header.writeUInt32LE(uncompressedSize, 22);
    header.writeUInt16LE(name.length, 26);
    header.writeUInt16LE(0, 28);
    name.copy(header, 30);

    return header;
}

function makeCentralHeader(
    entry: ZipEntry,
    compressedSize: number,
    uncompressedSize: number,
    crc: number,
    localOffset: number,
): Buffer {
    const name = Buffer.from(entry.name, "utf8");
    const header = Buffer.alloc(46 + name.length);

    header.writeUInt32LE(0x02014b50, 0);
    header.writeUInt16LE(entry.versionMadeBy, 4);
    header.writeUInt16LE(entry.versionNeeded, 6);
    header.writeUInt16LE(entry.flags & ~0x0008, 8);
    header.writeUInt16LE(entry.method, 10);
    header.writeUInt16LE(0, 12);
    header.writeUInt16LE(0, 14);
    header.writeUInt32LE(crc, 16);
    header.writeUInt32LE(compressedSize, 20);
    header.writeUInt32LE(uncompressedSize, 24);
    header.writeUInt16LE(name.length, 28);
    header.writeUInt16LE(0, 30);
    header.writeUInt16LE(0, 32);
    header.writeUInt16LE(0, 34);
    header.writeUInt16LE(0, 36);
    header.writeUInt32LE(entry.externalAttributes, 38);
    header.writeUInt32LE(localOffset, 42);
    name.copy(header, 46);

    return header;
}

function buildZip(entries: Array<{ entry: ZipEntry; content: Buffer }>): Buffer {
    const localParts: Buffer[] = [];
    const centralParts: Buffer[] = [];
    let offset = 0;

    for (const item of entries) {
        const entry = item.entry;
        const raw = item.content;
        const compressed =
            entry.method === 8
                ? deflateRawSync(raw)
                : raw;

        const crc = crc32(raw);
        const local = makeLocalHeader(
            entry,
            compressed.length,
            raw.length,
            crc,
        );

        localParts.push(local, compressed);

        centralParts.push(
            makeCentralHeader(
                entry,
                compressed.length,
                raw.length,
                crc,
                offset,
            ),
        );

        offset += local.length + compressed.length;
    }

    const central = Buffer.concat(centralParts);
    const locals = Buffer.concat(localParts);
    const eocd = Buffer.alloc(22);

    eocd.writeUInt32LE(0x06054b50, 0);
    eocd.writeUInt16LE(0, 4);
    eocd.writeUInt16LE(0, 6);
    eocd.writeUInt16LE(entries.length, 8);
    eocd.writeUInt16LE(entries.length, 10);
    eocd.writeUInt32LE(central.length, 12);
    eocd.writeUInt32LE(locals.length, 16);
    eocd.writeUInt16LE(0, 20);

    return Buffer.concat([locals, central, eocd]);
}

export class DocxDocument {

    private readonly entries: ZipEntry[];

    constructor(
        private readonly archive: Buffer,
    ) {
        this.entries = parseZip(archive);
    }

    public getText(): string {
        const document = this.findEntry("word/document.xml");
        const xml = entryContent(document).toString("utf8");

        const parts: string[] = [];
        const token = /<w:(?:t|tab|br)\b[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/w:t>|<w:tab\b[^>]*\/>|<w:br\b[^>]*\/>/g;

        let match: RegExpExecArray | null;
        while ((match = token.exec(xml)) !== null) {
            if (match[0].startsWith("<w:tab")) {
                parts.push("\t");
            }
            else if (match[0].startsWith("<w:br")) {
                parts.push("\n");
            }
            else {
                parts.push(xmlDecode(match[1] ?? ""));
            }
        }

        return parts.join("");
    }

    public replaceText(
        find: string,
        replace: string,
    ): { archive: Buffer; replacements: number } {

        if (!find) {
            throw new Error("The find text cannot be empty.");
        }

        const document = this.findEntry("word/document.xml");
        const xml = entryContent(document).toString("utf8");

        const direct = xml.split(xmlEscape(find)).length - 1;

        if (direct === 1) {
            const updatedXml =
                xml.replace(
                    xmlEscape(find),
                    xmlEscape(replace),
                );

            return {
                archive: this.rebuild(updatedXml),
                replacements: 1,
            };
        }

        if (direct > 1) {
            throw new Error(`The requested text occurs ${direct} times. Refusing an ambiguous edit.`);
        }

        throw new Error(
            "The requested text was not found as one contiguous Word text run. Use a more specific phrase or edit the document in Word.",
        );
    }

    private findEntry(name: string): ZipEntry {
        const entry = this.entries.find(item => item.name === name);

        if (!entry) {
            throw new Error(`DOCX entry ${name} was not found.`);
        }

        return entry;
    }

    private rebuild(documentXml: string): Buffer {
        return buildZip(
            this.entries.map(entry => ({
                entry,
                content:
                    entry.name === "word/document.xml"
                        ? Buffer.from(documentXml, "utf8")
                        : entryContent(entry),
            })),
        );
    }
}
</file>

<file path="server/src/modules/integrations/IntegrationsController.ts">
import type {
    Request,
    Response,
    NextFunction,
} from "express";

import { MicrosoftOAuthService } from "./microsoft/MicrosoftOAuthService.js";

export class IntegrationsController {

    constructor(
        private readonly microsoft: MicrosoftOAuthService,
    ) {}

    public status = async (
        _req: Request,
        res: Response,
        next: NextFunction,
    ): Promise<void> => {
        try {
            res.json({
                microsoft: await this.microsoft.status(),
            });
        }
        catch (error) {
            next(error);
        }
    };

    public connectMicrosoft = (
        _req: Request,
        res: Response,
        next: NextFunction,
    ): void => {
        try {
            res.redirect(
                this.microsoft.createAuthorizationUrl(),
            );
        }
        catch (error) {
            next(error);
        }
    };

    public microsoftCallback = async (
        req: Request,
        res: Response,
        next: NextFunction,
    ): Promise<void> => {
        try {
            const code =
                String(req.query.code ?? "");

            const state =
                String(req.query.state ?? "");

            if (!code || !state) {
                throw new Error(
                    "Microsoft OAuth callback did not contain code/state.",
                );
            }

            await this.microsoft.handleCallback(
                code,
                state,
            );

            res.type("html").send(`
<!doctype html>
<html>
<head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>JustAI</title></head>
<body style="font-family: sans-serif; padding: 40px">
<h2>Microsoft connected</h2>
<p>You can close this window and return to JustAI.</p>
<script>window.close()</script>
</body>
</html>
`);
        }
        catch (error) {
            next(error);
        }
    };

    public disconnectMicrosoft = async (
        _req: Request,
        res: Response,
        next: NextFunction,
    ): Promise<void> => {
        try {
            await this.microsoft.disconnect();

            res.json({
                success: true,
            });
        }
        catch (error) {
            next(error);
        }
    };
}
</file>

<file path="server/src/modules/integrations/IntegrationsRoutes.ts">
import { Router } from "express";
import type { IntegrationsController } from "./IntegrationsController.js";

export function createIntegrationsRouter(
    controller: IntegrationsController,
): Router {
    const router = Router();

    router.get(
        "/status",
        controller.status,
    );

    router.get(
        "/microsoft/connect",
        controller.connectMicrosoft,
    );

    router.get(
        "/microsoft/callback",
        controller.microsoftCallback,
    );

    router.post(
        "/microsoft/disconnect",
        controller.disconnectMicrosoft,
    );

    return router;
}

<file path="server/src/modules/websocket/WebSocketConnectionManager.ts">
import { WebSocketServer, WebSocket } from 'ws';
import type { Server as HttpServer } from 'node:http';

export class WebSocketConnectionManager {

    private server?: WebSocketServer;

    private readonly clients =
        new Set<WebSocket>();

    public attach(
        httpServer: HttpServer,
    ): void {

        this.server = new WebSocketServer({
            server: httpServer,
        });

        this.server.on(
            'connection',
            (socket) => {

                this.clients.add(socket);

                socket.on(
                    'close',
                    () => {
                        this.clients.delete(socket);
                    },
                );

                socket.on(
                    'error',
                    () => {
                        this.clients.delete(socket);
                    },
                );

            },
        );

    }

    public broadcast(
        message: unknown,
    ): void {

        const payload =
            JSON.stringify(message);

        for (const client of this.clients) {

            if (
                client.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN
            ) {

                client.send(payload);

            }

        }

    }

    public getClientCount(): number {

        return this.clients.size;

    }

}
</file>

<file path="server/src/modules/websocket/WebSocketGateway.ts">
import { EventBus } from '../../core/events/index.js';
import {
    FileCreatedEvent,
    FileSavedEvent,
    FileDeletedEvent,
    FileMovedEvent,
    FileRenamedEvent,
} from '../../core/events/index.js';

import { WebSocketConnectionManager } from './WebSocketConnectionManager.js';

export class WebSocketGateway {

    constructor(
        private readonly eventBus: EventBus,
        private readonly connectionManager: WebSocketConnectionManager,
    ) {}

    public initialize(): void {

        this.eventBus.subscribe(
            FileCreatedEvent,
            {
                handle: async (event) => {
                    this.connectionManager.broadcast({
                        type: 'FILE_CREATED',
                        path: event.path,
                        timestamp: event.timestamp,
                    });
                },
            },
        );

        this.eventBus.subscribe(
            FileSavedEvent,
            {
                handle: async (event) => {
                    this.connectionManager.broadcast({
                        type: 'FILE_SAVED',
                        path: event.path,
                        timestamp: event.timestamp,
                    });
                },
            },
        );

        this.eventBus.subscribe(
            FileDeletedEvent,
            {
                handle: async (event) => {
                    this.connectionManager.broadcast({
                        type: 'FILE_DELETED',
                        path: event.path,
                        timestamp: event.timestamp,
                    });
                },
            },
        );

        this.eventBus.subscribe(
            FileRenamedEvent,
            {
                handle: async (event) => {
                    this.connectionManager.broadcast({
                        type: 'FILE_RENAMED',
                        oldPath: event.oldPath,
                        newPath: event.newPath,
                        timestamp: event.timestamp,
                    });
                },
            },
        );

        this.eventBus.subscribe(
            FileMovedEvent,
            {
                handle: async (event) => {
                    this.connectionManager.broadcast({
                        type: 'FILE_MOVED',
                        source: event.source,
                        destination: event.destination,
                        timestamp: event.timestamp,
                    });
                },
            },
        );

    }

}
</file>

<file path="server/src/modules/workspace/validators/CreateFileValidator.ts">
import {
    Validator,
    ValidationResult,
} from '../../../core/validation/index.js';

import { CreateFileDto } from '../dto/CreateFileDto.js';

export class CreateFileValidator
    extends Validator<CreateFileDto> {

    public validate(
        data: unknown,
    ): ValidationResult<CreateFileDto> {

        if (
            typeof data !== 'object' ||
            data === null
        ) {

            return this.failure(
                'Request body must be an object.',
            );

        }

        const dto =
            data as Partial<CreateFileDto>;

        const path =
            this.requiredString(
                dto.path,
                'path',
            );

        if (!path.success) {

            return path;

        }

        const content =
            this.optionalString(
                dto.content,
                'content',
            );

        if (!content.success) {

            return content;

        }

        return this.success({

            path: path.value!,

            content: content.value,

        });

    }

}

<file path="server/src/modules/workspace/WorkspaceController.ts">
import {
    Request,
    Response,
    NextFunction,
} from 'express';

import { WorkspaceService } from './WorkspaceService.js';

import { SaveFileDto } from './dto/SaveFileDto.js';
import { CreateFileDto } from './dto/CreateFileDto.js';
import { CreateFolderDto } from './dto/CreateFolderDto.js';
import { DeletePathDto } from './dto/DeletePathDto.js';
import { RenamePathDto } from './dto/RenamePathDto.js';
import { MovePathDto } from './dto/MovePathDto.js';

import { ValidationError } from '../../core/errors/ValidationError.js';

import { CreateFileValidator } from './validators/CreateFileValidator.js';

export class WorkspaceController {

    constructor(
        private readonly workspaceService: WorkspaceService,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Дерево проекта
     */
    public getTree = async (
        req: Request,
        res: Response,
        next: NextFunction,
    ) => {

        try {

            const tree =
                await this.workspaceService.getTree();

            res.json(tree);

        }
        catch (error) {

            next(error);

        }

    };

    /**
     * Получение файла
     */
    public getFile = async (
        req: Request,
        res: Response,
        next: NextFunction,
    ) => {

        try {

            const path =
                String(
                    req.query.path ?? '',
                );

            const file =
                await this.workspaceService.readFile(
                    path,
                );

            res.json(file);

        }
        catch (error) {

            next(error);

        }

    };

    /**
     * Сохранение файла
     */
    public saveFile = async (
        req: Request,
        res: Response,
        next: NextFunction,
    ) => {

        try {

            const dto =
                req.body as SaveFileDto;

            await this.workspaceService.saveFile(
                dto,
            );

            res.json({

                success: true,

            });

        }
        catch (error) {

            next(error);

        }

    };

    /**
     * Создание файла
     */
    public createFile = async (
        req: Request,
        res: Response,
        next: NextFunction,
    ) => {

        try {

            const validator =
                new CreateFileValidator();

            const result =
                validator.validate(
                    req.body,
                );

            if (!result.success) {

                throw new ValidationError(
                    result.message!,
                );

            }

            await this.workspaceService.createFile(
                result.value!,
            );

            res.status(201).json({

                success: true,

            });

        }
        catch (error) {

            next(error);

        }

    };

    /**
     * Создание папки
     */
    public createFolder = async (
        req: Request,
        res: Response,
        next: NextFunction,
    ) => {

        try {

            const dto =
                req.body as CreateFolderDto;

            await this.workspaceService.createFolder(
                dto,
            );

            res.status(201).json({

                success: true,

            });

        }
        catch (error) {

            next(error);

        }

    };

    /**
     * Удаление файла или папки
     */
    public deletePath = async (
        req: Request,
        res: Response,
        next: NextFunction,
    ) => {

        try {

            const dto =
                req.body as DeletePathDto;

            await this.workspaceService.deletePath(
                dto,
            );

            res.json({

                success: true,

            });

        }
        catch (error) {

            next(error);

        }

    };

    /**
     * Переименование
     */
    public renamePath = async (
        req: Request,
        res: Response,
        next: NextFunction,
    ) => {

        try {

            const dto =
                req.body as RenamePathDto;

            await this.workspaceService.renamePath(
                dto,
            );

            res.json({

                success: true,

            });

        }
        catch (error) {

            next(error);

        }

    };

    /**
     * Перемещение
     */
    public movePath = async (
        req: Request,
        res: Response,
        next: NextFunction,
    ) => {

        try {

            const dto =
                req.body as MovePathDto;

            await this.workspaceService.movePath(
                dto,
            );

            res.json({

                success: true,

            });

        }
        catch (error) {

            next(error);

        }

    };

}
</file>

<file path="server/src/modules/workspace/WorkspaceRoutes.ts">
import { Router } from 'express';

import { WorkspaceController } from './WorkspaceController.js';



export function createWorkspaceRouter(
    controller: WorkspaceController,
): Router {


    const router =
        Router();



    router.get(
        '/tree',
        controller.getTree,
    );



    router.get(
        '/file',
        controller.getFile,
    );



    router.put(
        '/file',
        controller.saveFile,
    );



    router.post(
        '/file',
        controller.createFile,
    );



    router.post(
        '/folder',
        controller.createFolder,
    );


    router.delete(
        '/',
        controller.deletePath,
    );

    router.post(
        '/rename',
        controller.renamePath,
    );

    router.post(
        '/move',
        controller.movePath,
    );

    return router;

}
</file>

<file path="server/src/modules/workspace/WorkspaceService.ts">
import { DirectoryScanner } from '../../infrastructure/filesystem/DirectoryScanner.js';
import { LocalFileSystem } from '../../infrastructure/filesystem/LocalFileSystem.js';
import { PathResolver } from '../../infrastructure/filesystem/PathResolver.js';

import { NotFoundError } from '../../core/errors/NotFoundError.js';

import { SaveFileDto } from './dto/SaveFileDto.js';
import { CreateFileDto } from './dto/CreateFileDto.js';
import { CreateFolderDto } from './dto/CreateFolderDto.js';
import { DeletePathDto } from './dto/DeletePathDto.js';
import { RenamePathDto } from './dto/RenamePathDto.js';
import { MovePathDto } from './dto/MovePathDto.js';

import {
    EventBus,
    FileCreatedEvent,
    FileSavedEvent,
    FileDeletedEvent,
    FileMovedEvent,
    FileRenamedEvent,
} from '../../core/events/index.js';

export class WorkspaceService {

    constructor(
        private readonly fileSystem: LocalFileSystem,
        private readonly pathResolver: PathResolver,
        private readonly directoryScanner: DirectoryScanner,
        private readonly eventBus: EventBus,
    ) {}

    /**
     * Возвращает дерево проекта
     */
    public async getTree() {

        return this.directoryScanner.scan();

    }

    /**
     * Чтение файла
     */
    public async readFile(
        relativePath: string,
    ) {

        const absolutePath =
            this.pathResolver.resolve(
                relativePath,
            );

        const exists =
            await this.fileSystem.exists(
                absolutePath,
            );

        if (!exists) {

            throw new NotFoundError(
                'File not found.',
            );

        }

        const content =
            await this.fileSystem.readFile(
                absolutePath,
            );

        return {

            path: relativePath,

            content,

        };

    }

    /**
     * Сохранение файла
     */
    public async saveFile(
        dto: SaveFileDto,
    ): Promise<void> {

        const absolutePath =
            this.pathResolver.resolve(
                dto.path,
            );

        const exists =
            await this.fileSystem.exists(
                absolutePath,
            );

        if (!exists) {

            throw new NotFoundError(
                'File not found.',
            );

        }

        await this.fileSystem.writeFile(
            absolutePath,
            dto.content,
        );

        await this.eventBus.publish(
            new FileSavedEvent(
                dto.path,
            ),
        );

    }

    /**
     * Создание файла
     */
    public async createFile(
        dto: CreateFileDto,
    ): Promise<void> {

        const absolutePath =
            this.pathResolver.resolve(
                dto.path,
            );

        await this.fileSystem.writeFile(
            absolutePath,
            dto.content ?? '',
        );

        await this.eventBus.publish(
            new FileCreatedEvent(
                dto.path,
            ),
        );

    }

    /**
     * Создание папки
     */
    public async createFolder(
        dto: CreateFolderDto,
    ): Promise<void> {

        const absolutePath =
            this.pathResolver.resolve(
                dto.path,
            );

        await this.fileSystem.mkdir(
            absolutePath,
        );

    }

    /**
     * Удаление файла или папки
     */
    public async deletePath(
        dto: DeletePathDto,
    ): Promise<void> {

        const absolutePath =
            this.pathResolver.resolve(
                dto.path,
            );

        const exists =
            await this.fileSystem.exists(
                absolutePath,
            );

        if (!exists) {

            throw new NotFoundError(
                'Path not found.',
            );

        }

        await this.fileSystem.delete(
            absolutePath,
        );

        await this.eventBus.publish(
            new FileDeletedEvent(
                dto.path,
            ),
        );

    }

    /**
     * Переименование
     */
    public async renamePath(
        dto: RenamePathDto,
    ): Promise<void> {

        const oldPath =
            this.pathResolver.resolve(
                dto.oldPath,
            );

        const newPath =
            this.pathResolver.resolve(
                dto.newPath,
            );

        const exists =
            await this.fileSystem.exists(
                oldPath,
            );

        if (!exists) {

            throw new NotFoundError(
                'Path not found.',
            );

        }

        await this.fileSystem.rename(
            oldPath,
            newPath,
        );

        await this.eventBus.publish(
            new FileRenamedEvent(
                dto.oldPath,
                dto.newPath,
            ),
        );

    }

    /**
     * Перемещение файла или папки
     */
    public async movePath(
        dto: MovePathDto,
    ): Promise<void> {

        const sourcePath =
            this.pathResolver.resolve(
                dto.source,
            );

        const destinationPath =
            this.pathResolver.resolve(
                dto.destination,
            );

        const exists =
            await this.fileSystem.exists(
                sourcePath,
            );

        if (!exists) {

            throw new NotFoundError(
                'Path not found.',
            );

        }

        await this.fileSystem.move(
            sourcePath,
            destinationPath,
        );

        await this.eventBus.publish(
            new FileMovedEvent(
                dto.source,
                dto.destination,
            ),
        );

    }

}
</file>

    const resolver = new PathResolver(process.cwd());
    const ignore = new IgnoreService(process.cwd());
    await ignore.initialize();
    const scanner = new DirectoryScanner(new LocalFileSystem(), resolver, ignore);
    const tree = await scanner.scan();
    console.dir(tree, {
        depth: null,
    });
}

<file path="README.md">
# JustAI 0.2

JustAI is a local AI IDE with an agent runtime, tool calling, multiple AI providers, local workspace editing, and external service integrations.

## What is included

### Agent system

- General Agent
- Code Agent
- Office Agent
- Multi-step agent loop with a configurable step limit
- Tool registry and tool executor
- Provider selection per request

### Local workspace tools

- `read_file`
- `list_files`
- `edit_file`

The local tools are restricted to the JustAI workspace and cannot escape it.

### AI providers

- Mock provider for offline development and tests
- OpenAI Responses API
- Anthropic Messages API

Provider API keys stay on the server and are never sent to the browser.

### Microsoft Word / OneDrive

JustAI includes a Microsoft OAuth connection and OneDrive integration.

The Office Agent can:

- read text from `.docx` files stored in OneDrive;
- replace exact text in a `.docx` document;
- upload the modified document back to OneDrive;
- return the Word/OneDrive URL when available;
- request an edit sharing link when Microsoft Graph allows it.

Microsoft Graph manages the OneDrive file and permissions; the actual Word document content is edited locally as OOXML and then uploaded back. Microsoft Graph itself does not expose a general Word editing API, so this architecture follows the supported download/edit/upload pattern.

## Requirements

- Node.js 22+
- npm 10+

## Install

From the project root:

```bash
npm run install:all
```

Or install manually:

```bash
npm install
npm install --prefix server
npm install --prefix apps/web
```

## Configure the server

Copy:

```text
server/.env.example
```

to:

```text
server/.env
```

### Offline development

The default provider is:

```env
JUSTAI_PROVIDER=mock
```

This requires no API key.

### OpenAI

```env
JUSTAI_PROVIDER=openai
OPENAI_API_KEY=...
OPENAI_MODEL=gpt-5.6
```

### Anthropic

```env
JUSTAI_PROVIDER=anthropic
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=...
ANTHROPIC_MODEL=claude-sonnet-4-6
```

The provider can also be selected directly in the web UI.

## Microsoft Word / OneDrive setup

Create an app registration in Microsoft Entra ID.

Set the redirect URI to:

```text
http://localhost:4302/api/integrations/microsoft/callback
```

Use delegated permissions for:

- `openid`
- `profile`
- `offline_access`
- `User.Read`
- `Files.ReadWrite`

Then configure:

```env
MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID=...
MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET=...
MICROSOFT_TENANT=common
MICROSOFT_REDIRECT_URI=http://localhost:4302/api/integrations/microsoft/callback
JUSTAI_ENCRYPTION_KEY=<long-random-secret>
```

`JUSTAI_ENCRYPTION_KEY` is used to encrypt the local Microsoft refresh-token file.

After starting JustAI, open the Agent panel and press:

```text
Connect
```

The connection is stored locally on the server.

## Run

Backend:

```bash
npm run dev
```

Frontend:

```bash
npm run dev:web
```

Backend:

```text
http://localhost:4302
```

Frontend:

```text
http://localhost:3000
```

Health check:

```text
http://localhost:4302/api/health
```

## Agent examples

Local project:

```text
прочитай README.md и объясни проект
```

```text
покажи файлы в папке server/src/modules/ai
```

```text
измени файл server/src/modules/ai/README.md: замени "old" на "new"
```

Microsoft Word:

```text
Прочитай Word документ Documents/Contract.docx
```

```text
В Word документе Documents/Contract.docx замени "старый текст" на "новый текст"
```

For production use, prefer exact quoted text for Word edits. The built-in document editor intentionally refuses ambiguous or cross-run replacements instead of silently modifying the wrong text.

## Build

Backend type-check/build:

```bash
npm run build:server
```

Frontend:

```bash
npm run build:web
```

Both:

```bash
npm run build
```

## Architecture

```text
Browser
  |
  +-- IDE
  |    +-- File tree
  |    +-- Text editor
  |    +-- Agent chat
  |    +-- Provider selector
  |    +-- Microsoft connection
  |
  v
Express API
  |
  +-- AIService
  |    +-- Agent profiles
  |    +-- ProviderFactory
  |    +-- Agent loop
  |    +-- ToolRegistry
  |
  +-- Workspace API
  |
  +-- Integrations API
       +-- Microsoft OAuth
       +-- Microsoft Graph
       +-- Word tools
```

## Security model

- API keys remain on the backend.
- Microsoft refresh tokens are encrypted at rest.
- Local file tools are constrained to the workspace.
- AI tools are filtered by agent profile.
- Ambiguous local edits are rejected.
- Ambiguous Word replacements are rejected.
- External integrations are opt-in.

## Current scope

This release establishes the agent platform and integration foundation rather than pretending that every external service is already implemented.

The next integrations can follow the same adapter pattern:

```text
Integration
  +-- OAuth / connection
  +-- API client
  +-- tools
  +-- routes
  +-- UI connection card
```

This makes Google Docs, GitHub, Slack, Notion, and other services additive instead of requiring changes to the core agent runtime.

## AI Council — browser accounts, no API keys

JustAI includes an experimental browser-based AI Council. It can use your existing web accounts in persistent local browser profiles for:

- ChatGPT
- Claude
- DeepSeek

No provider API key is required for this mode. JustAI opens a visible Edge/Chromium window, you sign in yourself, and the local browser profile keeps the session for later runs.

The council assigns roles such as:

- Architect
- Critic
- Implementer
- Researcher
- Chair

The selected advisors receive the same task and local project context. The chair receives the advisors' answers and produces one implementation plan. The browser council is deliberately advisory in this first version: it does not directly write project files from a website response. Local JustAI tools remain the only mechanism that changes the workspace, and an explicit execution step should be used before applying a council plan.

### First council run on Windows

1. Run `start-justai.cmd`.
2. Open the **AI Council** section in the right panel.
3. Click **Подключить** for ChatGPT, Claude and/or DeepSeek.
4. A visible browser opens for each provider. Sign in manually in each window.
5. Return to JustAI and click **Созвать AI Council**.

Sessions are stored under:

```text
.justai/browser-profiles/
```

Do not copy this directory to another machine and do not commit it to Git. It contains browser session data.

### Browser engine

The Windows launcher uses Microsoft Edge when available. To use Playwright Chromium instead, set:

```env
JUSTAI_BROWSER_CHANNEL=
```

and run:

```bash
npx playwright install chromium
```

The browser council is a compatibility layer over normal web pages. A provider can change its UI or block automation; if that happens, JustAI reports the provider error instead of pretending the council completed successfully.
</file>

<file path="start-justai.cmd">
@echo off
setlocal EnableExtensions
cd /d "%~dp0"

echo ========================================
echo JustAI 2.0 - Windows launcher
echo ========================================

echo.
echo [1/5] Installing/checking dependencies...
call npm install
if errorlevel 1 goto :fail
call npm install --prefix server
if errorlevel 1 goto :fail
call npm install --prefix apps/web
if errorlevel 1 goto :fail

echo.
echo [2/5] Preparing Playwright browser council...
set JUSTAI_BROWSER_CHANNEL=msedge
set JUSTAI_COUNCIL_TIMEOUT_MS=120000

if not exist "server\.env" (
  copy /Y "server\.env.example" "server\.env" >nul
)

powershell -NoProfile -Command "$p='server/.env'; $s=Get-Content $p -Raw; if($s -notmatch 'JUSTAI_BROWSER_CHANNEL='){Add-Content $p 'JUSTAI_BROWSER_CHANNEL=msedge'}"

where msedge.exe >nul 2>&1
if errorlevel 1 echo WARNING: Microsoft Edge was not found on PATH. Install Edge or set JUSTAI_BROWSER_CHANNEL= in server/.env to use Playwright Chromium.

echo.
echo [3/5] Starting backend...
start "JustAI Backend" cmd /k "cd /d "%~dp0" && npm run dev --prefix server"

powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ok=$false; for($i=0;$i -lt 60;$i++){try{$r=Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing http://localhost:4302/api/health -TimeoutSec 1;if($r.StatusCode -eq 200){$ok=$true;break}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500}; if(-not $ok){exit 1}"
if errorlevel 1 (
  echo Backend did not become ready.
  goto :fail
)

echo Backend is ready.

echo.
echo [4/5] Starting frontend...
start "JustAI Web" cmd /k "cd /d "%~dp0" && npm run dev:web"

powershell -NoProfile -Command "$ok=$false; for($i=0;$i -lt 60;$i++){try{$r=Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing http://localhost:3000/ -TimeoutSec 1;if($r.StatusCode -eq 200){$ok=$true;break}}catch{};Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500}; if(-not $ok){exit 1}"
if errorlevel 1 (
  echo Frontend did not become ready.
  goto :fail
)

echo Frontend is ready.

echo.
echo [5/5] Opening JustAI...
start "" http://localhost:3000/

echo.
echo ========================================
echo JustAI is running.
echo Web:     http://localhost:3000/
echo Backend: http://localhost:4302/api/health
echo ========================================
echo.
echo Do not close the Backend/Web terminal windows while using JustAI.
exit /b 0

:fail
echo.
echo ========================================
echo START FAILED

echo ========================================
pause
exit /b 1
</file>

<file path="start-justai.ps1">
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Set-Location $PSScriptRoot
Write-Host 'JustAI 2.0 - Windows launcher' -ForegroundColor Cyan

npm install
npm install --prefix server
npm install --prefix apps/web

if (!(Test-Path 'server/.env')) { Copy-Item 'server/.env.example' 'server/.env' }
$env:JUSTAI_BROWSER_CHANNEL = 'msedge'
$env:JUSTAI_COUNCIL_TIMEOUT_MS = '120000'

Start-Process powershell -ArgumentList '-NoExit','-Command',"Set-Location '$PSScriptRoot'; npm run dev --prefix server"

for ($i=0; $i -lt 60; $i++) {
    try { if ((Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing 'http://localhost:4302/api/health').StatusCode -eq 200) { break } } catch {}
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
}

Start-Process powershell -ArgumentList '-NoExit','-Command',"Set-Location '$PSScriptRoot'; npm run dev:web"

for ($i=0; $i -lt 60; $i++) {
    try { if ((Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing 'http://localhost:3000/').StatusCode -eq 200) { break } } catch {}
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
}

Start-Process 'http://localhost:3000/'
Write-Host 'JustAI is running: http://localhost:3000/' -ForegroundColor Green
</file>
